title: 摄影棚机车模特写真摆拍
prompt:
Action: 
Sitting on a motorcycle, body leaning slightly forward, both hands holding the handlebars, one leg bent and stepping on the side of the vehicle or the footrest, the other leg naturally landing on the ground to support the center of gravity; head turned toward the camera, smiling at the camera, overall looking like a relaxed car model pose in a studio.
Background: 
Simple studio background, light-colored seamless backdrop wall, softboxes and lighting equipment on both sides, light-colored studio floor with a touch of real studio feel.

Front-side eye-level slightly low angle, vertical full-body composition, completely showing the person and the motorcycle, leaning towards a commercial studio portrait angle.

骑坐在摩托车上，身体微微前倾，双手握住车把，一条腿弯曲踩在车身侧面或脚踏上，另一条腿自然落地支撑重心；头部转向镜头，微笑看向镜头，整体像摄影棚里的轻松车模摆拍。

title: 暗黑甜酷猫系社媒美妆写真
prompt:
Real photography, real person, social media beauty portrait and dark sweet cool cat-style look, vertical 3:4 ratio, half-body close-up, eye-level slightly close shot, subject occupies about 75% of the frame, head positioned towards the top and centered, minimalist cold blue gradient background with negative space. Adult female, cold white to ivory skin tone, light pink blush on cheeks and fine freckle makeup, the right side of the skin has a slight color cast from the blue-cyan ambient light; long black curly hair, center-parted wispy bangs, black suede cat ear hair accessory, silver chain hanging from the cat ears to the forehead with a small cross pendant in the center. Body slightly turned to the right, shoulders and neck slightly tucked forward, one side of the shoulder and arm exposed; the left hand is raised from the bottom left of the frame, the index finger's nail and pad press diagonally against the lower lip towards the left side of the frame, retaining local indentation of the lower lip, interruption of the lip line, slight narrowing of the mouth opening, and breakpoints in the lip surface highlights, do not let it become a hovering finger or a simple light touch. Eyes naturally open but with a relaxed expression, the upper edge of the iris is normally covered by the upper eyelid, the pupils are overall angled towards the right of the frame (the person's own left), not looking directly at the camera; lips slightly parted, deep red moist lip makeup. Black lace choker fitting the neck with pearl reflections, silver earrings, rings, and thin upper arm chains are cold and bright. Soft light from the front-left brightens the face, cold blue rim light on the right side, black hair and black accessories with the blue background dominate, deep red lip color as a small accent; mid-to-high definition mobile phone / CCD photo texture, slight skin smoothing, soft focus beauty effect, low noise in the background, hair strands and silver chains are locally sharp. Avoid anime/illustration style, avoid common fresh profile pictures, avoid overly clean studio shots, avoid looking directly at the camera, avoid losing the deformation of the lips under pressure.

title: 室内精英风格东亚女性低角度全身人像
prompt:
[Replace these first]
Scene: [café / hotel lobby / bookstore / lounge]
Top: [knit top / blazer + silk inner top / silk shirt / wine-red top]
Bottom: [black mini skirt / black skirt]
Stockings: [sheer grey / sheer black]
Shoes: [black pointed heels]
Prop: [coffee cup / book / wine glass]

Create a 9:16 vertical realistic portrait of a young adult East Asian woman with a “boss lady” vibe. She should look 25–29, pretty, polished, graceful, and full of charm, with youthful refined features, bright expressive eyes, real skin texture, and a calm confident expression. She should have a slight urban wife / executive-sister aura, but must not look old, matronly, or like a stiff businesswoman.

She is seated on a leather chair in [Scene], photographed from a clearly low angle with a subtle upward perspective. Full body visible. Legs naturally crossed and extending toward the bottom of the frame, creating depth and presence. Proportions must stay natural, with complete feet and shoes, no oversized front shoe.

She wears [Top], [Bottom], [Stockings], and [Shoes], and holds [Prop] naturally in one hand. The other hand rests on the chair armrest or near her lap. Her head is slightly raised, and she looks to the side or slightly upward, not directly at the camera. The mood feels calm, elegant, in control, and quietly powerful.

Premium indoor background, warm ambient light mixed with soft directional side light, realistic materials, realistic skin, realistic fabric texture, polished lifestyle photography.

场景：[咖啡馆 / 酒店大堂 / 书店 / 休息室]
上装：[针织衫 / 西装夹克+丝绸内搭 / 丝绸衬衫 / 酒红色上衣]
下装：[黑色迷你裙 / 黑色裙子]
丝袜：[透灰丝袜 / 透黑丝袜]
鞋子：[黑色尖头高跟鞋]
道具：[咖啡杯 / 书籍 / 酒杯]

创建一个 9:16 垂直比例的年轻东亚成年女性写实肖像，具有“女老板”气质。她看起来应该是 25-29 岁，漂亮、考究、优雅且充满魅力，拥有年轻精致的面容、明亮传神的眼睛、真实的皮肤纹理以及冷静自信的表情。她应该带有一种轻微的都市妻子/高管姐姐的气场，但绝不能显得老气、大妈感或像刻板的女商人。

她坐在 [场景] 的皮椅上，拍摄角度明显较低，带有微妙的向上透视。全身可见。双腿自然交叉并向画面底部延伸，创造深度感和存在感。比例必须保持自然，双脚和鞋子完整，不要出现过大的前脚。

她穿着 [上装]、[下装]、[丝袜] 和 [鞋子]，一只手自然地握着 [道具]。另一只手搁在椅子扶手或大腿附近。她的头微扬，看向侧面或略微向上，不直视镜头。氛围感觉冷静、优雅、掌控全局且力量内敛。

高级室内背景，温暖的环境光混合柔和的有向侧光，写实的材质，写实的皮肤，写实的织物纹理，考究的生活方式摄影。

title: 极简奢侈风工作室超写实时装大片
prompt:
Use the face in the reference photo. Maintain the subject’s natural facial features, realistic facial proportions, authentic likeness, natural skin texture, visible pores, and soft realistic facial details.

Create an ultra-realistic vertical fashion studio editorial portrait inspired by a luxury minimalist photo studio pictorial. The subject is seated low on the studio floor near the lower-left side of the frame, leaning softly against a warm greige studio wall. Keep a lot of empty space above and around her, creating a quiet high-fashion magazine composition with a clean luxury studio mood.

The pose should closely follow the inspiration: the subject is sitting on the floor with one leg folded inward across the front of her body and the other leg bent upward with the knee raised, creating a sharp elegant editorial leg shape. Her body is slightly angled toward the camera, shoulders relaxed, posture low and confident. One arm rests naturally near her lap while the other arm is partly hidden under the oversized coat. Her gaze is directed straight into the camera with a calm, mysterious, slightly sultry expression. Lips are softly parted, not smiling. The pose should feel expensive, composed, quiet, and fashionable.

The outfit is a chic winter-luxury fashion-house inspired look. She wears a fitted matte black high-neck turtleneck mini dress or sleek black bodysuit-style mini dress. The black outfit should be body-hugging, minimal, clean, and elegant, creating a strong contrast with the pale warm background. Over it, she wears an oversized shaggy faux-fur coat in warm taupe-beige, camel beige, and light brown tones. The coat is worn open and draped loosely off the shoulders and arms, with long fluffy textured fur fibers, dramatic volume, and an expensive editorial feel. The fur should look soft, heavy, realistic, and dimensional, not flat.

She wears sheer black nylon tights with a soft translucent finish, elegant and slightly glossy under the studio light. The heels are glossy black patent leather pointed-toe stiletto pumps with slim high heels, sharp elegant toe shape, and a subtle red sole detail visible from the side. The shoes should look luxurious and sleek with realistic patent-leather reflections, no visible logo.

Her hairstyle is very long, thick, voluminous dark chocolate-brown hair styled in soft messy waves. The hair has a high-fashion undone texture, full volume at the roots, fluffy movement, and natural shine. Use a soft center part or slightly off-center part, with long face-framing layers and airy waves falling over the shoulders and chest. The hair should feel glamorous, romantic, slightly wild, and editorial, not overly polished.

Makeup is soft sultry Korean-inspired glam. Skin has a smooth satin finish with realistic pores, soft natural highlights, and subtle contour along the nose and jawline. Eyes have warm taupe-brown eyeshadow, softly blended smoky depth, thin black eyeliner with a delicate elongated wing, defined lashes, and a slightly smoked lower lash line. Brows are softly shaped and natural. Cheeks have muted rose-beige blush, with delicate highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge, nose tip, and inner corners of the eyes. Lips are glossy nude rose-brown with a softly blurred lip line and slightly parted expression. Overall makeup should look elegant, feminine, expensive, and quietly seductive.

The background is a minimalist studio wall and floor in a warm greige / muted ivory-gray color, not pure white. The wall has a soft matte texture with subtle imperfections, faint shadows, and a realistic studio corner atmosphere. 

Lighting is soft directional studio lighting from the front-left, creating gentle shadows on the wall and floor. Keep the overall color palette muted and luxurious: matte black, sheer black, glossy black patent leather, taupe beige, camel beige, warm greige, soft brown, and muted ivory-gray.

使用参考照片中的脸。保持受试者自然的脸部特征、真实的脸部比例、真实的相似度、自然的皮肤纹理、可见的毛孔和柔和真实的脸部细节。

创作一张超写实的垂直时尚工作室社论肖像，灵感来自奢华极简主义摄影工作室画报。受试者低坐在工作室地板上，靠近画面的左下侧，轻轻地靠在温暖的米灰色工作室墙壁上。在她上方和周围保留大量空白空间，营造出一种干净、奢华工作室氛围的静谧时尚杂志构图。

姿势应紧跟灵感：受试者坐在地板上，一条腿向内折叠在身体前方，另一条腿向上弯曲，膝盖抬起，营造出犀利优雅的社论腿部线条。她的身体略微朝向相机，肩膀放松，姿态低调且自信。一只手自然地放在大腿附近，另一只手部分隐藏在超大外套下。她的目光直视相机，神情冷静、神秘且略显性感。双唇微启，不带微笑。姿势应显得昂贵、沉稳、安静且时尚。

服装是受时尚大牌启发的时尚冬季奢华造型。她穿着一件贴身的哑光黑色高领毛衣连衣裙或光滑的黑色连体衣风格超短裙。黑色装扮应紧身、极简、干净且优雅，与淡雅温暖的背景形成强烈对比。外搭一件由暖灰褐色、骆驼色和浅棕色调组成的超大蓬松人造皮草外套。外套敞开穿着，随意地披在肩膀和手臂上，具有长而蓬松的有纹理皮草纤维、戏剧性的体积感和昂贵的社论感。皮草看起来应该是柔软、厚重、真实且立体的，而不是扁平的。

她穿着黑色透明尼龙丝袜，带有柔和的半透明质感，在工作室灯光下显得优雅且微亮。高跟鞋是黑色亮面漆皮尖头细高跟鞋，鞋跟纤细，鞋头形状犀利优雅，从侧面可以看到细微的红底细节。鞋子看起来应该奢华且光滑，带有真实的漆皮反光，无可见徽标。

promptEn:
Use the face in the reference photo. Maintain the subject’s natural facial features, realistic facial proportions, authentic likeness, natural skin texture, visible pores, and soft realistic facial details.

Create an ultra-realistic vertical fashion studio editorial portrait inspired by a luxury minimalist photo studio pictorial. The subject is seated low on the studio floor near the lower-left side of the frame, leaning softly against a warm greige studio wall. Keep a lot of empty space above and around her, creating a quiet high-fashion magazine composition with a clean luxury studio mood.

The pose should closely follow the inspiration: the subject is sitting on the floor with one leg folded inward across the front of her body and the other leg bent upward with the knee raised, creating a sharp elegant editorial leg shape. Her body is slightly angled toward the camera, shoulders relaxed, posture low and confident. One arm rests naturally near her lap while the other arm is partly hidden under the oversized coat. Her gaze is directed straight into the camera with a calm, mysterious, slightly sultry expression. Lips are softly parted, not smiling. The pose should feel expensive, composed, quiet, and fashionable.

The outfit is a chic winter-luxury fashion-house inspired look. She wears a fitted matte black high-neck turtleneck mini dress or sleek black bodysuit-style mini dress. The black outfit should be body-hugging, minimal, clean, and elegant, creating a strong contrast with the pale warm background. Over it, she wears an oversized shaggy faux-fur coat in warm taupe-beige, camel beige, and light brown tones. The coat is worn open and draped loosely off the shoulders and arms, with long fluffy textured fur fibers, dramatic volume, and an expensive editorial feel. The fur should look soft, heavy, realistic, and dimensional, not flat.

She wears sheer black nylon tights with a soft translucent finish, elegant and slightly glossy under the studio light. The heels are glossy black patent leather pointed-toe stiletto pumps with slim high heels, sharp elegant toe shape, and a subtle red sole detail visible from the side. The shoes should look luxurious and sleek with realistic patent-leather reflections, no visible logo.

Her hairstyle is very long, thick, voluminous dark chocolate-brown hair styled in soft messy waves. The hair has a high-fashion undone texture, full volume at the roots, fluffy movement, and natural shine. Use a soft center part or slightly off-center part, with long face-framing layers and airy waves falling over the shoulders and chest. The hair should feel glamorous, romantic, slightly wild, and editorial, not overly polished.

Makeup is soft sultry Korean-inspired glam. Skin has a smooth satin finish with realistic pores, soft natural highlights, and subtle contour along the nose and jawline. Eyes have warm taupe-brown eyeshadow, softly blended smoky depth, thin black eyeliner with a delicate elongated wing, defined lashes, and a slightly smoked lower lash line. Brows are softly shaped and natural. Cheeks have muted rose-beige blush, with delicate highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge, nose tip, and inner corners of the eyes. Lips are glossy nude rose-brown with a softly blurred lip line and slightly parted expression. Overall makeup should look elegant, feminine, expensive, and quietly seductive.

The background is a minimalist studio wall and floor in a warm greige / muted ivory-gray color, not pure white. The wall has a soft matte texture with subtle imperfections, faint shadows, and a realistic studio corner atmosphere. 

Lighting is soft directional studio lighting from the front-left, creating gentle shadows on the wall and floor. Keep the overall color palette muted and luxurious: matte black, sheer black, glossy black patent leather, taupe beige, camel beige, warm greige, soft brown, and muted ivory-gray.

title: 高级时尚杂志封面泳池度假大片
prompt:
[Character] Image 1 [Signature] A small Meta-operated Threads logo is placed in the bottom right corner, with the signature-like "CHAse" written in small white handwritten script above it. 

[Character's Pose and Expression] Propped up on the edge of a cool emerald pool with both hands, as if hesitating to emerge from the water, pushing the pool bottom with palms, with thighs exposed above the water surface, staring at the camera in a seductive pose. The head is tilted slightly back, elegantly displaying the jawline and neck curves, with half-open lips and a haughty yet charming gaze, exuding the overwhelming charm characteristic of high-end fashion magazine covers. The character's upper body is oriented 90 degrees toward the left side of the frame.

[Character's Clothing] Wearing a classic yet bold charcoal black high-end dress with a deep V-neck slit. The upper part is decorated with exquisite three-dimensional silver bead embroidery details, finely crafted, while the skirt part consists of voluminous and heavy black feather decorations that appear slightly wet, perfectly interpreting a luxurious summer glamour look.

[Character's Hair and Makeup Details] Smooth wet hair combed straight back as if just coming out of the pool (wet hair styling). Makeup is based on brown smoky eye makeup that emphasizes deep and soft eyes, paired with a calm matte nude-beige lipstick. Adorned with ornate long silver drop earrings reminiscent of lizards or chains, and a chunky chain silver necklace around the neck, adding sparkling highlights.

[Lighting and Light Direction] Artificial soft lighting like a professional pictorial shoot, with light gently falling on the left cheek and a relatively strong shadow forming on the right cheek. The shimmer of the pool water surface and sunlight create smooth highlights on the character's right shoulder, collarbone, and cheeks, clearly highlighting a healthy and elastic skin texture.

[Texture and Tone Atmosphere] The cool turquoise blue of the pool water, the heavy dark tones of the dress, and the strong red of the magazine title form a perfect visual contrast. The metallic texture of the sparkling bead embroidery, the soft texture of the feathers, and the transparent quality of the water rippling in the sunlight blend together to create a sophisticated high-end resort pictorial atmosphere.

[Film and Lens Depth of Field, Angle] Shot using an aperture of f/2.8, shutter speed of 1/1000 second, ISO 100, and a 50mm standard prime lens. To capture the most attractive silhouette of the character sitting on the pool deck, a medium shot composition from eye-level height at a slight side angle. The character's face and the front of the clothing are in razor-sharp focus, while the rippling water surface in the background is softly blurred, giving the character a sense of complete immersion.

[Background Elements (Optional)] The background consists of a grey stone pool deck with a delicate textured surface and an emerald pool water surface shimmering bright white in the sunlight. To match the magazine layout, a large red bold "BLANC" logo is placed at the top without obscuring the character's face, layered behind the face. Sophisticated white and red fashion typography combining Greek and English such as "CHASE", "WHAT'S SEXY NOW" are sensually overlaid in the left and right spaces.

[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小巧地放置着，其上方以白色手写体小字写着像签名一样的“CHAse”。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
在清凉的翡翠色泳池边缘双手撑着，仿佛要从水中浮起又犹豫不决，用手掌推着池底，大腿直到水面外露的状态，凝视着镜头的妖娆姿势。高头微微后仰，优雅地展现出下巴线条和颈部曲线，半张开的嘴唇以及高傲却又迷人的眼神，散发着高级时尚杂志封面特有的压倒性魅力。人物的上半身朝框架左侧90度方向。  

[人物服装]  
穿着经典却大胆的胸前深V开叉的炭黑色高级感礼服。上身饰有精致立体的银色珠绣细节，精细绣制而成，裙部则由略微湿润般丰盈厚重的黑色羽毛装饰构成，完美诠释奢华的夏日魅力造型。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
仿佛刚从泳池中出来般，水湿后整齐向后梳拢的顺滑湿发（湿发造型）。妆容以强调眼部深邃柔和的棕色烟熏眼妆为基础，嘴唇搭配沉稳哑光的裸色米色调唇膏。耳朵上戴着令人联想到蜥蜴或链条的华丽长款银色水滴耳坠，脖子上佩戴粗犷链式银色项链，增添闪耀的亮点。  

[照明及光线方向]  
如同专业画报拍摄般的人工柔和光线，人物左侧脸颊微微洒落光线，而右侧脸颊则相对形成强烈的阴影。泳池水面反射的粼光和阳光在人物右侧肩膀、锁骨以及脸颊上营造出平滑的高光，清晰凸显健康富有弹性的肌肤质感。  

[质感与色调氛围]  
泳池水色的清凉青绿色（Turquoise Blue）与礼服的厚重深色调，以及杂志标题的强烈红色（Red），在视觉上形成完美的对比。闪耀珠绣的金属质感、羽毛的柔软纹理，以及阳光下荡漾的水的透明质感交织融合，营造出精致高端的度假画报氛围。  

[胶片及镜头景深、角度]  
使用光圈 f/2.8、快门速度 1/1000 秒、ISO 100、焦距 50mm 标准定焦镜头拍摄。人物坐在泳池平台（Deck）上最具魅力的造型轮廓，为了最吸引人地捕捉，从眼平高度略微侧面拍摄的中景构图。人物的面部和服装正面锐利如刀刃般清晰对焦，而后方荡漾的水面涟漪则柔和地虚化处理，赋予人物完整的沉浸感。  

[背景元素（可选）]

prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic editorial studio photograph set against a smooth off-white seamless backdrop with a bright, airy minimalist aesthetic.

A fun-loving young woman with a pastel blue pixie cut is captured in a spontaneous moment of playful escape. She bursts into laughter while jogging forward, her smile wide and genuine, eyes nearly closed from amusement. Her posture shows energetic movement as she tries to continue running despite being gently held back, creating a humorous tug-of-war effect.

Pose & Movement

Natural mid-stride running motion.

One leg lifted slightly off the floor.

Arms moving freely with realistic running dynamics.

One hand confidently holding a vibrant rainbow spiral lollipop.

Subtle motion in the hair and clothing.

Strong sense of forward momentum with believable body mechanics.

Wardrobe

Loose oversized powder-blue sweatshirt.

Relaxed-fit beige trousers with wide legs.

Red checkerboard slip-on skate shoes.

Round eyeglasses casually resting atop her head rather than covering her eyes.

A simple hand-drawn black doodle figure appears beside her, sketched in thick marker lines directly onto the photograph. The character features a round head, tiny dot eyes, and a straight neutral mouth.

The doodle extends an exaggerated arm that grips the back of the woman's sweatshirt, stretching the fabric noticeably as it attempts to stop her from getting away. The tension creates realistic folds and pull lines in the sweatshirt while subtly drawing her shoulders backward even as her body continues moving forward.

Small sketch-style motion marks around the doodle's arm suggest effort and resistance. Additional playful doodle accents around the woman's head emphasize her laughter, excitement, and movement.

Details

Anatomically accurate hands and fingers.

Clear visibility of both hands despite oversized sleeves.

Realistic grip and proportions on the lollipop.

Convincing fabric tension and clothing physics.

Bright high-key lighting with soft natural shadows.

Clean editorial lifestyle photography aesthetic.

Humorous visual storytelling.

Modern premium magazine-quality look.

Wholesome and playful mood.

Ultra-realistic textures, sharp focus, crisp detail, 8K resolution.

title: 极简复古旅行海报插画
prompt:
Create a minimalist vintage travel poster illustration of [CITY / DESTINATION], inspired by modern editorial tourism art and Japanese travel magazine covers. Use soft pastel colors, clean vector-style linework, subtle textures, and elegant flat shading. The composition should feel calm, airy, and inviting, with a large amount of negative space and refined typography.

Scene:
Show the destination's most iconic landmark from a beautiful wide-angle perspective. Include tourists casually walking, taking photos, relaxing, sketching, cycling, or enjoying coffee to create a peaceful everyday atmosphere. Add lush greenery, flowers, palm trees (if tropical), calm water reflections, birds, soft clouds, and bright natural daylight.

Style:
Minimalist vector illustration, Scandinavian + Japanese editorial design, premium tourism poster, soft muted color palette, ultra-clean geometric architecture, smooth gradients, subtle paper grain texture, balanced composition, high-end magazine aesthetic, cozy and elegant.

Typography:
Large elegant serif title at the top-left:
"[CITY NAME]"

创作一张 [城市 / 目的地] 的极简复古旅行海报插画，灵感源自现代编辑类旅游艺术和日本旅行杂志封面。使用柔和的粉彩色调、干净的矢量风格线条、细腻的纹理和优雅的平面阴影。构图应让人感到平静、轻盈且迷人，拥有大量的负空间和精致的排版。

场景：
从优美的广角视角展示该目的地最标志性的地标。包含随意走动、拍照、放松、素描、骑行或享用咖啡的游客，以营造一种宁静的日常生活氛围。加入郁郁葱葱的植被、花卉、棕榈树（如果是热带地区）、平静的水面倒影、鸟类、柔和的云朵和明亮的自然日光。

风格：
极简矢量插画，斯堪的纳维亚 + 日本编辑设计，高端旅游海报，柔和且低饱和度的色调，极净的几何建筑，平滑的渐变，细腻的纸张颗粒纹理，平衡的构图，高端杂志审美，舒适且优雅。

排版：
左上角的大型优雅衬线标题：
"[城市名称]"

title: 90年代经典日漫风格人像
prompt:
Transform the uploaded photo into a highly detailed portrait in the style of authentic 1990s Japanese anime. Preserve the person's recognizable facial features, hairstyle, expression, and overall identity, but reinterpret them as if they were a character from a classic 90s anime series.

Art Style: Inspired by iconic 90s anime aesthetics such as Sailor Moon, Yu Yu Hakusho, Cowboy Bebop, Neon Genesis Evangelion, and Slam Dunk. Hand-painted cel animation look, clean inked outlines, subtle airbrushed shading, slightly imperfect linework, and traditional animation textures.

Character Design: Make the character look rebellious, cheeky, and charismatic—confident smirk, mischievous eyes, slightly messy hair, relaxed posture, and a cool "don't care" attitude. Add small details like a leather jacket, oversized shirt, rolled-up sleeves, earrings, bandages, or vintage accessories that fit a 90s anime delinquent aesthetic.

Color Palette: Use intentionally unflattering and slightly muted 90s anime colors—washed-out reds, dusty blues, olive greens, pale skin tones, and soft gradients. Avoid modern vibrant digital colors. Include subtle film grain and cel-paint imperfections.

Lighting & Atmosphere: Soft cinematic lighting with nostalgic late-90s anime mood, slight bloom, VHS-era color grading, and a hand-painted background inspired by urban streets, train stations, school rooftops, or neon-lit alleys.

Quality: Authentic hand-drawn cel animation appearance, nostalgic 1990s Japanese anime frame, highly detailed, cinematic composition, retro anime screenshot aesthetic, no modern AI look, no 3D rendering, no hyper-realistic textures.

角色设计：让角色看起来叛逆、调皮且富有魅力——自信的假笑、淘气的眼睛、略显凌乱的发型、放松的姿势和酷酷的“不在乎”态度。添加小细节，如皮夹克、超大号衬衫、卷起的袖子、耳环、绷带或符合 90 年代动漫不良美学的复古配饰。

title: 斑驳树影下的淡蓝裙日式人像
prompt:
Theme:
Mottled light blue tree shadows

Character · Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige toned fair skin, with a slight pinkish healthy glow, smooth and delicate skin texture. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, not overly retouched, but preserving natural skin texture. A naturally rounded adult female body shape, not appearing childish. Elegant and sophisticated makeup, like an exquisite Japanese doll makeup. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal, light brown soft eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small, clear catchlights in the pupils. A serene expression, with a slightly relaxed direct gaze.

Clothing · Pose:
A light ice blue sleeveless camisole-style wrap dress. Thin shoulder straps, an elegant overlapping V-neck design at the chest, natural draping from the waist to the hips, a deep slit on the left side, soft and thin fabric hanging down along the legs. The hair is a bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layering around the face, and a casual updo loosely pinned at the back of the head. Hair strands scattered on the shoulders, delicate highlights, and a soft luster should all be carefully depicted. Sitting on the edge of a wooden porch, using her right hand on the wooden board beside her body to support her upper body. The left hand gently pinches the hem of the dress, with fingers naturally curved. The body is slightly slanted to one side, adding a natural twist at the shoulders and waist.

Background · Lighting:
A porch and green garden of a summer Japanese-style residence. On the right are wooden window frames and pillars, on the left and in the distance are lush green leaves, with blurred house roofs and garden trees in the far background. The main light source is bright summer sunlight entering from the upper left of the frame, creating mottled light spots through the leaves on the shoulders, hair, dress, and wooden floor. Shadows extend towards the bottom right of the frame. Soft reflected green light from the garden blends into the skin, and the background is bright and blurred. Not overexposed, creating a humid and transparent afternoon atmosphere.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 2:3 composition. A medium-shot portrait from the waist to the thighs, including the sitting figure. The face is located in the upper third of the frame, with the person slightly to the right, leaving green negative space on the left. The lens naturally approaches from an angle slightly below eye level, with a slight compression similar to an 85mm portrait lens. The focus is on the pupils and around the face, with the background and foreground leaves softly blurred with a shallow depth of field. Depth is created using the horizontal line of the wooden floor and the window frames.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Natural light portrait, bright and transparent summer colors, slightly soft highlights, the delicate texture of the skin, every strand of hair, the thinness and wrinkles of the fabric, and the dry texture of the wood must all be carefully expressed. Avoid excessive processing or a CG feel, pursuing a clean texture like a magazine photo.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, overly childish face, exaggerated body shape, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, deformed joints, poor contact of the hand holding the skirt, floating fabric, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, overexposed skin, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, excessively wet skin, broken clothing structure, unnecessary other people or props, text, logos, watermarks.

主题：
树影斑驳的淡蓝色

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着微微粉红的血色，肌质光滑细腻。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，不是过度美肌修饰，而是保留自然的肌理纹理。成年女性般的自然圆润体型，不会显得幼稚。妆容精致优雅，宛如精巧的日系娃娃妆。淡玫瑰粉腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色眼影、细长浓密的睫毛、自然的泪袋、浅棕色柔和眉毛、透亮粉米色唇彩。瞳孔中有细小清澈的捕捉光。表情宁静，略带放松的直视目光。

服装·姿势：
淡冰蓝色的无袖吊带式裹身连衣裙。细肩带，胸前优雅的V字重叠设计，从腰部到臀部自然褶皱，左侧有较深的开衩，柔软轻薄的面料顺着腿部垂落。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色。薄薄的透视刘海，脸部周围的层次感，后脑勺松散挽起的随意盘发。肩头散落的发丝、细腻的高光、柔和的光泽，都要仔细描绘。坐在木质走廊边缘，用自己的右手撑在身体侧边的木板上支撑上半身。左手轻轻捏住裙摆，指尖自然弯曲。身体略微斜向一侧，在肩部和腰部加入自然的扭转。

背景·光线：
夏日日式住宅的走廊与绿意庭院。右侧是木质窗框和柱子，左侧和远处是浓绿的树叶，远景中模糊的住宅屋顶和庭木。主光源从画面左上方进入的明亮夏日阳光，透过树叶的光斑洒在肩头、头发、连衣裙和木地板上，形成斑驳高光。阴影向画面右下方延伸。肌肤上融入庭院绿色的柔和反射光，背景明亮且虚化。不至于过度过曝，营造出午后湿润感的透明空气。

构图·镜头：
纵向2:3构图。从腰部到大腿的中景肖像，包含坐姿人物。脸部位于画面上部三分之一处，人物略偏右，左侧留有绿色的空白余白。镜头从略低于视线的角度自然靠近，类似85mm肖像镜头的轻微压缩感。焦点在瞳孔和脸部周围，背景与前景的树叶以浅景深柔和虚化。用木地板的水平线和窗框营造纵深感。

质感·风格：
逼真的照片风AI图像。自然光肖像，明亮透明的夏日色彩，略带柔和的高光，肌肤的细腻质感、每一根头发、布料的薄透与褶皱、木材的干燥纹理，都要仔细表现。避免过度加工或CG感，追求干净如杂志照片般的质感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、过于幼稚的脸庞、过度夸张的体型、多余或缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、握裙手部的接触不良、漂浮的布料、不自然的引力、光源矛盾的阴影、过度过曝的肌肤、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、过分的湿润肌肤、服装结构崩坏、不必要的其他人物或道具、文字、标志、水印。

prompt:
use the attached image as the main facial reference while preserving recognizable identity essence, facial proportions, natural asymmetry, facial harmony, and natural facial character.

A candid mid-2000s CCD digicam beauty portrait captured indoors during a quiet evening. The subject is framed in an extreme close-up, face filling almost the entire frame, looking softly toward the camera with relaxed half-lidded eyes and softly parted glossy lips. A few loose dark espresso-brown hair strands fall naturally along the side of the face, while the background remains softly dim and unobtrusive.

She wears a dramatic pearl-and-crystal statement choker with bare shoulders and delicate evening styling. Makeup follows the reference styling with luminous champagne shimmer across the eyelids, soft smoky liner, separated lashes, feathered brush-up brows, peach-coral baby blush, subtle freckles, and glossy light coral-pink lips. Her skin appears fair with a warm tan undertone, not dark or orange, featuring creamy ivory highlights, honey-beige midtones, and softly lifted cocoa-brown shadow separation with preserved detail and realistic pores.

Camera rendering: authentic premium mid-2000s CCD compact digital camera with thick optical zoom lens, weak built-in flash fill mixed with dim indoor ambient lighting, lower exposure by about one and a half stop, reduced micro-contrast, less clarity, subtle CCD noise, mild JPEG compression, creamy reflective highlights, and soft edge rendering. Reflective highlights naturally appear on the lips, nose bridge, cheekbones, eyelids, pearl necklace, crystals, and hair strands without looking oily or HDR.

Color science: rich nostalgic white-balance drift with a subtle reddish-brown bias, not desaturated. Blacks and shadows remain softly lifted with preserved detail, gently drifting toward warm espresso-brown and faded chocolate tones rather than becoming deep or crushed. Reds shift into soft coral-orange. Neutrals gently drift toward warm chestnut-beige. Whites become creamy ivory with a faint reddish-brown warmth. Yellows become pale apricot cream. Greens lean warm yellow-olive. Blues drift gently toward deep faded teal. Colors remain rich while feeling naturally aged through authentic early-2000s CCD white-balance behavior rather than vintage filtering.

Composition: extreme close-up beauty framing with the eyes, lips, cheeks, and pearl choker as the main visual anchors. Slight handheld imperfection, subtle Dutch tilt, imperfect crop, and spontaneous indoor beauty snapshot realism.

Mood: intimate, nostalgic, luminous, dreamy, softly subdued, like a forgotten premium 2006 CCD evening beauty photograph with lifted chocolate-brown shadows, lower exposure, weak flash fill, low clarity, creamy reflective highlights, and authentic early-digital character.

--ar 4:5

Negative prompt: modern smartphone HDR, DSLR bokeh, cinematic grading, excessive clarity, ultra-detailed sharpness, clinical digital rendering, crushed blacks, high-contrast shadows, dull makeup, deep terracotta lips, orange fake tan, pale lifeless skin, oily skin, plastic skin, beauty filter, waxy face, over-smoothed skin, harsh flash, overexposed highlights, stiff pose, AI fashion pose, distorted face, duplicated facial features, text, watermark.

一张2000年代中期CCD数码相机的随拍美女肖像，是在一个安静的夜晚在室内拍摄的。主体采用极近距离特写构图，脸部几乎填满整个画面，眼神柔和地看向镜头，眼睑半垂，嘴唇微张且富有光泽。几缕深浓缩咖啡褐色的碎发自然地垂在脸侧，而背景保持柔和昏暗且不显眼。

title: 游戏进化史诗：从实体主机中喷涌而出的像素洪流
prompt:
Concept: A timeline of gaming history emerging from physical consoles. Input: [Resident Evil] (e.g., Mario, Zelda, Final Fantasy) System Instruction: Act as a Gaming Historian. Create a 2x2 Grid of "Console Architecture." Evolution Logic: Select 4 eras of the franchise (8-bit, 64-bit, HD, VR). The Container: The base is the Physical Console/Controller of that era (e.g., NES Controller, N64 Console, Disc Drive). The Glitch: The game world "glitches" out of the cartridge slot or disc tray, turning into physical voxels or polygons. Panel 1 (8-Bit): The world is made of Lego-like plastic blocks. Panel 2 (Poly): The world is made of Sharp, low-poly folded paper. Panel 3 (HD): The world is Photorealistic Resin. The HUD: Holographic UI elements (Health bars, Ammo) float physically above the scene. Label: The front of the console features the Game Logo in chrome.

概念：游戏历史时间线从实体游戏机中浮现。 输入：[Resident Evil]（例如：马力欧、塞尔达、最终幻想） 系统指令： 扮演一位游戏历史学家。创建一个 2x2 的“主机架构”网格。 演变逻辑：选择该系列游戏的 4 个时代（8 位、64 位、高清、VR）。 容器：基础是该时代的实体游戏机/控制器（例如：NES 控制器、N64 主机、光盘驱动器）。 故障：游戏世界从卡带插槽或光盘托盘中“故障”出来，变成物理体素或多边形。 面板 1（8 位）：世界由乐高般的塑料积木构成。 面板 2（多边形）：世界由锋利、低多边形的折纸构成。 面板 3（高清）：世界是照片级的树脂材质。 HUD：全息 UI 元素（生命条、弹药）物理地漂浮在场景上方。 标签：主机正面以镀铬的游戏标志为特色。
promptEn: Concept: A timeline of gaming history emerging from physical consoles. Input: [Resident Evil] (e.g., Mario, Zelda, Final Fantasy) System Instruction: Act as a Gaming Historian. Create a 2x2 Grid of "Console Architecture." Evolution Logic: Select 4 eras of the franchise (8-bit, 64-bit, HD, VR). The Container: The base is the Physical Console/Controller of that era (e.g., NES Controller, N64 Console, Disc Drive). The Glitch: The game world "glitches" out of the cartridge slot or disc tray, turning into physical voxels or polygons. Panel 1 (8-Bit): The world is made of Lego-like plastic blocks. Panel 2 (Poly): The world is made of Sharp, low-poly folded paper. Panel 3 (HD): The world is Photorealistic Resin. The HUD: Holographic UI elements (Health bars, Ammo) float physically above the scene. Label: The front of the console features the Game Logo in chrome.

title: 网络迷因文化的微缩博物馆艺术装置
prompt:
Input A is an internet viral moment or meme origin (meme name, video screenshot, or cultural phenomenon). Analyze the original context, why it resonated, cultural impact, and spread pattern. Optional Input B is a style reference (pop culture museum / internet archive). If missing, choose Gen Z nostalgia meets contemporary art aesthetic. Goal: Ironic-but-premium display containing the exact viral moment in miniature form, with figurines, props, and screens showing spread metrics. Exact pose, position, and reaction of the characters should be replicated. Rules: - Recreate the exact scene with 2-8 figurines - Include miniature phone/camera capturing the moment - Show tiny screens with share counts, platforms, timeline - Add "before viral" vs "after viral" comparison elements - Mix irony with genuine appreciation for internet culture - Label with moment/meme name, origin date, platform, shares/views Output: ONE image, 1:1 social media optimized format

title: 泰式水上乐园的电影感光影少女
prompt:

Behind her, elaborate ancient Thai/Asian-inspired stone architecture rises, featuring tall intricately carved columns, elegant thatched-roof pavilions, and a large amphitheater stage with professional lighting rigs in the distance. Lush green forested hills and distant misty mountains frame the scene under an overcast cloudy sky, soft diffused natural light illuminating the environment. She wears a light blue long-sleeve athletic rash guard top with a subtle white logo, a black sports skirt layered over black leggings, and a white baseball cap adorned with sparkling crystal/jewel embellishments. Her hair is slightly damp, her skin naturally glowing in the misty humid atmosphere, and she smiles subtly, looking directly at the camera. Photorealistic textures: detailed skin pores, wet fabric, water reflections, sand grains, carved stone surfaces, and foliage. Cinematic composition with shallow depth of field, volumetric mist, soft natural lighting, subtle lens flare, high contrast, ultra-realistic reflections and refractions, dramatic but natural color grading, 8k, hyper-detailed, ultra-photorealistic, cinematic style, immersive tropical environment.

title: 现代公寓走廊里的中国外卖女骑手生活照
prompt:
A candid phone photo of a young Chinese woman in her mid-20s standing in a modern apartment building hallway, looking down at her phone. She has dark hair pulled up in a messy high bun with loose strands falling around her face. She wears an unzipped bright yellow-and-black food delivery rider jacket worn open over a beige low-cut fitted camisole with thin straps, the tight stretchy fabric hugging her full bust and slim waist, paired with light grey skin-tight leggings that cling to her wide hips and thick thighs, and chunky beige-white dad sneakers. Her figure is strikingly curvy — the combination of the tight cami and leggings traces every contour clearly. She holds a phone in her left hand, eyes down reading the screen with her mouth slightly open mid-word. Her right arm carries a large black insulated food delivery bag with a yellow kangaroo logo hanging at her side. The hallway behind her has polished marble tile floors, cream-colored walls, and elevator doors with a small green indicator light. The photo is shot from inside an apartment doorway looking out at her, the dark door frame visible on both edges creating a natural vignette. Harsh overhead hallway fluorescent lighting, slightly yellow-tinted, casting unflattering but real shadows under her chin and on the floor. Shot on a phone camera, slightly noisy, the unpolished quality of a real moment — someone opened their door to get their food delivery and snapped a photo.

一张抓拍的手机照片，画面中是一位二十多岁的年轻中国女性，站在现代公寓大楼的走廊里，正低头看手机。她黑色的头发扎成凌乱的高发髻，脸颊垂下几缕碎发。她穿着一件拉链拉开的明亮黄黑相间外卖骑手夹克，夹克内搭一件米色低胸修身细吊带背心，紧身弹力面料勾勒出她丰满的胸部和纤细的腰肢，下身穿着浅灰色紧身打底裤，紧紧包裹着她宽阔的臀部和丰盈的大腿，脚蹬一双厚底米白色老爹运动鞋。她的身材曲线非常突出——紧身背心和打底裤的组合清晰地勾勒出每一处轮廓。她左手拿着手机，低头看着屏幕，嘴巴微张，像是在说话。她的右臂提着一个挂在身侧的带有黄色袋鼠标志的大型黑色绝缘外卖送餐包。她身后的走廊铺着抛光大理石地砖，奶油色墙壁，电梯门上有一个绿色的小指示灯。照片是从公寓门口向外拍摄她的，两侧可见深色门框，形成天然的虚光效果。走廊上方刺眼的荧光灯光略微偏黄，在她的下巴下和地板上投射出虽不美观但真实的阴影。由手机摄像头拍摄，略有噪点，具有真实时刻未经修饰的质感——就像某人开门取外卖时拍下的一张照片。

title: 高级极简平面矢量城市旅游海报
prompt:
Premium minimal flat-vector travel poster for [CITY_NAME], 3:4 vertical. Create a fresh, elegant city-specific travel illustration with the city’s iconic landmark as the main focus, plus local transport, everyday lifestyle moment, native nature detail, and unique composition. 

Japanese stationery aesthetic, luxury sticker illustration, clean thin outlines, flat colors, soft minimal shapes. Place [CITY_NAME] in the upper-left with premium typography and a short refined caption. Use only 3–6 small natural figures doing city-specific activities. 

Palette: powder blue, sky blue, cream, beige, sage green with tiny blush accents. Calm, airy, high-end postcard style. No realism, no watercolor, no gradients, no heavy shading, no crowded scene, no generic tourist collage, no repeated layouts.

title: 现代无边框智能手机与黑金钢笔摄影
prompt:
A photorealistic product shot of a modern bezel-less smartphone placed at a slight angle on a matte black surface, with a black and gold fountain pen partially visible beside it, creating a sleek professional aesthetic. The phone features an ultra-thin futuristic design with curved corners and a high screen-to-body ratio, lit with soft cinematic lighting and subtle reflections. The screen shows a minimal lock screen UI with the time “10:43,” date “FRI, MAY 9,” status icons, and faint “Swipe up to unlock” text. prompt:

Scenes and imagery: Giant turquoise lotus leaf, orange-red water droplets, character silhouette, off-white background, minimalist rain lines. Composition and space: Small subject and large imagery composition, the lotus leaf covers from the top of the frame, the figure is located at the lower side, water droplets as visual focal points. Color control: Off-white as the background base, turquoise for the main lotus leaf, orange-red used only for a single drop of water and a small amount of reflection, the figure uses a small dark blue-black silhouette; avoid the whole image turning into a green filter. Light and texture: Bright post-rain natural light, micro-texture on the lotus leaf, highlights on the water droplets, light paper texture. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Supplementary requirements: The person should be small, the lotus leaf should be large, the image should be vivid and bright, avoid a gloomy or depressing rainy feeling.

Build the poster as a cinematic exploded-view composition where the product appears suspended in space, separated into its essential layers, materials, ingredients, components, textures, or sensory elements.

The goal is not technical instruction. The goal is visual storytelling.

Every floating layer should reveal something meaningful about the product:
- tech products reveal precision, lenses, chips, screens, light, signals, glass, metal, and intelligence
- food products reveal flavor, texture, ingredients, crumbs, cream, steam, sauce, crunch, or freshness
- beverage products reveal liquid energy, bubbles, ice, fruit, condensation, motion, and refreshment
- fashion products reveal fabric, stitching, sole structure, leather, mesh, motion, identity, and lifestyle
- beauty products reveal scent, botanicals, liquid, glass, skin glow, mist, ritual, and refinement
- luxury products reveal craft, heritage, materials, polish, shadows, and timeless design

Keep the product accurate, recognizable, sharp, and visually dominant.

Arrange the exploded elements with premium art direction, cinematic lighting, clean depth, polished reflections, strong negative space, dramatic shadows, and a clear visual hierarchy.

The image should feel like a world-class campaign poster: iconic, expensive, scroll-stopping, and specifically designed for this exact brand and product.

Do not use miniature people, tiny worlds, product monuments, or city-scale scenes.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language, with a short 3-word slogan.

Avoid copying any existing campaign. Create a fresh original visual system.

Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

为[BRAND]品牌的产品[PRODUCT]制作一张高级广告海报。

将海报构建为电影感的爆炸视图构图，产品悬浮在空间中，被分解为基本层级、材料、成分、组件、纹理或感官元素。

目的不是技术说明。目的是视觉叙事。

每一个悬浮层都应揭示出关于产品的有意义的信息：
- 科技产品揭示精密性、镜头、芯片、屏幕、光线、信号、玻璃、金属和智能
- 食品揭示风味、纹理、成分、碎屑、奶油、蒸汽、酱汁、脆度或新鲜度
- 饮料产品揭示液体能量、气泡、冰、水果、冷凝、运动和清爽感
- 时尚产品揭示面料、缝线、鞋底结构、皮革、网眼、运动、身份和生活方式
- 美容产品揭示香气、植物成分、液体、玻璃、皮肤光泽、薄雾、仪式和精致感
- 奢侈品揭示工艺、传承、材料、抛光、阴影和永恒的设计

保持产品准确、可辨认、锐利且在视觉上占主导地位。

以高级艺术指导、电影感灯光、清晰的深度、抛光的反射、强烈的负空间、戏剧性的阴影和清晰的视觉层级来排列爆炸元素。

图像应感觉像是世界级的活动海报：标志性的、昂贵的、令人驻足观看的，并且是专门为该品牌和产品设计的。

不要使用微缩人物、微小世界、产品纪念碑或城市规模的场景。

添加受品牌视觉语言启发的高级海报排版，并配上简短的3个单词的标语。

避免模仿任何现有的活动。创建一个新鲜的原创视觉系统。

纵横比：[RATIO]

title: 便利店前置镜头捕捉韩国女子生活瞬间
prompt:
Accidental candid iPhone front-camera photo captured inside a small neighborhood convenience store. A young Korean woman stands in the checkout line, casually wiping a trace of sweat from her forehead while balancing a shopping basket. She looks off to the side with a slightly impatient, distracted expression, completely unaware of the camera. Faded sage-green oversized cotton T-shirt, relaxed fit, loose braid draped over one shoulder. Natural skin texture with visible pores, subtle facial shine from indoor warmth, realistic imperfections, no beauty retouching. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting creates cool-toned shadows and a faint yellow-green store color cast. Authentic smartphone image quality from an older iPhone, slight motion blur on the moving hand, mild sensor noise, compressed detail, imperfect framing, spontaneous everyday moment. Cluttered convenience-store aisles and checkout displays in the background. A small guinea pig is barely visible near the bottom corner of the frame, appearing accidentally included in the shot.

title: 写实主体与趣味手绘涂鸦创意构图
prompt:
Create a cheerful, creative composition that blends a realistic subject with playful hand-drawn doodles and a subtle micro-story.

Subject:
[insert object / person / product — keep simple and recognizable]

Layout:
- Invisible clean grid system underneath
- Balanced, airy spacing (avoid clutter)
- Clear hierarchy: subject first, doodles second, micro details third

Doodles (IMPORTANT):
- Playful, expressive, slightly exaggerated
- Include: smiley faces, stars, sparkles, arrows, motion lines, cute icons
- Doodles must INTERACT with the subject (touching, pulling, lifting, reacting)

Micro Story:
- Add a tiny, fun narrative (e.g., doodle characters using the object, reacting to it)
- Keep it subtle and discoverable on second glance

Typography:
- Friendly sans-serif + handwritten notes
- Casual tone (not serious, not corporate)
- Include small fun labels or thoughts

Color:
- Base: white / soft cream
- Ink: soft black / dark grey
- Accents: 2–3 cheerful colors (yellow, sky blue, soft red, mint, etc.)

Lighting:
- Bright, soft, uplifting
- No harsh shadows

Style:
- Clean + playful + slightly imperfect
- Feels human, warm, and creative

Constraints:
- Do NOT overcrowd
- Every doodle must have purpose or interaction
- Keep subject clearly visible (no obstruction)
- Maintain breathing space

Mood:
[cheerful / curious / lighthearted / imaginative]Add a consistent visual signature:
- same doodle style across all designs
- same color accent system
- recurring tiny character

Introduce a “main doodle character” that appears in every composition interacting with different subjects.

Keep composition consistent across series:
- same framing
- same spacing logic
- same typography style

Goal:
Make the design instantly recognizable as part of a series.

创建一个愉快且富有创意的构图，将逼真的主体与俏皮的手绘涂鸦和微妙的小故事融为一体。

主体：
[插入物体 / 人 / 产品 — 保持简单且易于识别]

布局：
- 下方有看不见的干净网格系统
- 平衡且通透的间距（避免杂乱）
- 清晰的层级结构：主体第一，涂鸦第二，微观细节第三

涂鸦（重要）：
- 俏皮、富有表现力、略带夸张
- 包含：笑脸、星星、火花、箭头、运动线条、可爱的图标
- 涂鸦必须与主体互动（触摸、拉动、举起、反应）

微型故事：
- 添加一个微小、有趣的叙事（例如，涂鸦角色使用物体，对其做出反应）
- 保持微妙，在第二次看时才会被发现

排版：

title: 顶级彩虹糖全球广告大片超现实视觉方案
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium global Skittles campaign titled:

PAINT OUTSIDE THE FLAVOR.

This is not a candy advertisement.

It should feel like imagination escaping into the real world—where every Skittle unlocks a different burst of color, personality, and playful chaos.

The composition captures a stylish young creator skateboarding effortlessly through an old European-inspired city plaza immediately after a summer rain. The wet cobblestone streets act like giant mirrors, reflecting the vibrant architecture around them.

Instead of ordinary rain...

the sky is experiencing a "Flavor Storm."

Hundreds of glowing liquid droplets descend from the clouds—not water, but suspended streams of vibrant fruit-colored paint, sparkling candy dust, translucent syrup ribbons, floating fruit slices, tiny glowing stars, and shimmering sugar crystals.

Each droplet creates something extraordinary when it touches the ground.

Red drops bloom into swirling raspberry galaxies.

Yellow splashes become radiant citrus sunbursts.

Green impacts grow luminous lime vines made entirely from light.

Purple droplets unfold into miniature cosmic nebulas.

Orange impacts explode into energetic spirals of tropical fruit particles.

Every puddle becomes a living abstract artwork, transforming the entire street into an interactive rainbow masterpiece.

The subject glides confidently through this explosion of creativity, leaving glowing colorful wheel trails behind them while laughing naturally. Their white sneakers gradually collect splashes of every color, becoming wearable works of art.

Massive translucent candy ribbons float through the air, bending naturally around buildings, balconies, street lamps, cafés, and trees without ever feeling artificial.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography behaves like part of the artwork itself.

Large expressive paint-brush lettering stretches across the skyline:

COLOR HAS NO RULES.

Supporting campaign copy:

One handful. Infinite imagination.

Life deserves louder colors.

Every flavor leaves a mark.

Turn ordinary into unforgettable.

Playful graphic elements include:

• fruit burst indicators

• flavor spectrum charts

• splash icons

• hand-painted arrows

• candy constellation graphics

• sketchbook doodles

• rainbow paint streaks

• playful editorial stamps

• premium packaging callouts

Typography should feel hand-crafted, energetic, and deeply integrated into the painted environment.

---

COLOR PALETTE

Explosive rainbow spectrum

Electric magenta

Lemon yellow

Lime green

Ocean cyan

Tangerine orange

Rich violet

Brilliant white highlights

Highly saturated cinematic contrast balanced by realistic lighting.

---

PHOTOGRAPHY & ART DIRECTION

Luxury FMCG advertising

Premium lifestyle editorial

Hyper-realistic liquid simulations

Ultra-detailed fruit textures

Photorealistic reflections

Dynamic environmental storytelling

Natural expressions

Award-winning commercial photography

Shallow cinematic depth of field

High dynamic range

Ultra-realistic lighting

Rich color grading

prompt:
Subject:
Okinawa floating beach

People · Expression:
A female in her 20s. Healthy and mature body lines, naturally coordinated posture. Skin is a bright ivory beige tone of fairness, with a faint pinkish healthy glow, texture is smooth and delicate. No excessive overexposure, with soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Pore texture is moderately restrained, but does not appear unnaturally plastic-like. Light rose pink blush is applied to the cheeks, eyes have a gradient of champagne beige and pink brown. Long and thick eyelashes, slender lower lashes, with natural brightness in the tear bags. Eyebrows are light brown, in a soft arch. Lips are applied with a translucent pink-beige lip gloss, naturally shining in the center. The overall facial makeup is elegant and clean, a sophisticated doll-style Japanese makeup. Eyes closed, bathing in the sunlight, with a gentle smile.

Clothing · Pose:
A small floral pattern bikini with light pink and ivory as the main tones. The chest naturally presents a sense of three-dimensionality, and the tension of the fabric and its fit to the body are realistically perceptible. No sarong or waist wrap. The body is slightly floating off the beach, with the head towards the right side of the frame and the feet towards the left side, floating as if lying sideways. The left knee is slightly bent, the right leg is naturally straight, and the toes are relaxed and drooping. Hands are relaxed and naturally fit the body. The person's left hand is lightly placed around the lower abdomen to the waist, and the right hand is lightly placed near the side of the abdomen. Fingers are not overly spread, in a slightly curved natural state. Hair is long dark brown loose waves, flowing towards the bottom right of the frame with gravity.

Background · Lighting:
Bright white sand beach in Okinawa. The person is floating on the sand side, slightly away from the sea. In the distance are highly transparent turquoise blue ocean, white wave edges, rocky areas, lush tropical greenery, low-rise resort buildings, and the distant coastline. Elements such as tourists walking on the beach, people swimming, parasols, and lifeguard stands are naturally placed in the background, slightly blurred to the extent that they do not interfere with the protagonist. Strong midday sunlight shines diagonally from the top left of the frame, illuminating the shoulders, abdomen, and upper side of the legs. Shadows are cast from directly beneath the person slightly to the bottom left, forming realistic shadows with varying intensity along the unevenness of the sand. Light reflecting from the sea surface keeps the shadows on the skin from being too harsh, and the whiteness of the sand envelops the whole in brightness.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition. The person is generally placed from the lower half to the center-right of the frame, a medium-wide shot where the whole body is visible. The shot is taken from a low position close to the beach, with a natural angle slightly looking down. The floating sensation and the shadow distance are clearly communicated, leaving space between the body and the sand. The background coastline enters the top half, creating a beach photo with depth. The focus is on the person's face to the upper body, with the background slightly blurred, but retaining the characteristic ocean colors and the presence of tourists in Okinawa.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo style. Detailed depiction of strong summer sunlight, fine grains of white sand, natural glow of the skin, tension of the bikini fabric, the clumpiness of the hair, and the shadows falling on the sand. Colors use a bright and transparent tropical tone. Turquoise sea, white sand, and light pink swimwear are refreshingly coordinated. No excessive skin beautification or AI-style uniform skin is applied, retaining natural oiliness and soft shadows.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, broken wrists or elbows, excessively twisted body, insufficient floating sensation, body looking like it's touching the sand, no shadow, shadow direction contradicting the light source, sarong or waist wrap, extra fabric, excessively sexy poses, unnaturally exaggerated body shape, plastic-like skin, excessively overexposed skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

主题：
冲绳漂浮海滩

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。健康且成熟的体态线条，自然协调的姿势。肌肤是明亮的象牙米色调的白皙，带着淡淡的粉色血色，质感光滑细腻。没有过度过曝，脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处带有柔和的高光。毛孔感适度克制，但不显得像塑料般不自然。脸颊上施以淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，眼部是香槟米色与粉棕色的渐层。细长浓密的睫毛，纤细的下睫毛，眼袋处有自然的亮度。眉毛是浅棕色，柔和的拱形。嘴唇涂以透亮感的粉米色唇彩，中央自然闪耀。整体脸部妆容优雅洁净，精密的娃娃风日系妆容。闭着眼睛，沐浴在阳光中，温柔微笑。

服装・姿势：
以浅粉色和象牙白为主调的小花纹比基尼。胸部自然呈现立体感，布料的张力和与身体的贴合真实可感。不加腰间的丝巾或纱笼。身体从沙滩微微浮起，头部朝画面右侧、脚部朝画面左侧，像横卧般漂浮着。左腿膝盖微微弯曲，右腿自然伸直，脚尖松弛下垂。双手放松自然贴合身体。人物左手轻轻置于下腹部至腰部一带，右手轻轻贴于侧腹附近。手指不过度张开，呈轻微弯曲的自然状态。头发是较长的深棕色松散波浪，随着重力向画面右下方流动。

背景・光线：
冲绳明亮的白沙海滩。人物漂浮在离海稍远的沙滩一侧。远处是透明度极高的碧青色海洋、白色的浪花边缘、岩石区、南国浓郁的绿色、低矮的度假建筑，以及远方的海岸线。背景中自然配置海边漫步的游客、游泳的人、遮阳伞、救生员台等元素，以不干扰主角为度进行轻微模糊。正午强烈的阳光从画面左上方斜射，照亮肩膀、腹部和腿部上侧。影子从人物正下方略向左下方投落，沿沙子的凹凸形成浓淡有致的真实感影子。海面反射光线使肌肤的阴影不过于生硬，沙子的白皙将整体笼罩在明亮中。

构图・镜头：
纵向构图。人物大体置于画面下半部至中央右侧，全身可见的中宽幅镜头。镜头从靠近沙滩的低位拍摄，以略微俯视的自然角度。人物的漂浮感和影子距离清晰传达，身体与沙子之间留出空间。背景海岸线进入上半部，形成有深度的海滩照片。焦点在人物的脸部至上半身，背景轻微虚化，但保留冲绳特色的海洋色彩和游客的存在感。

质感・风格：
逼真的照片风格。细致描绘夏日强烈的日照、白沙的细小颗粒、肌肤的自然光泽、比基尼布料的张力、头发的束感，以及落于沙上的影子。色彩采用明亮透明的南国调性。碧蓝海洋、白沙、浅粉色泳装清爽协调。不施加过度美肌修饰或AI式的均匀肌肤，保留自然的油光和柔和阴影。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、多余或缺失的手指、手指融合、手腕或肘部的破损、身体过度扭曲、漂浮感不足、看起来像接触沙子的身体、无影子、影子方向与光源矛盾、腰间的丝巾或纱笼、多余布料、过度性感的姿势、不自然夸张的体型、塑料般的肌肤、过度过曝的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

20多岁的女性。健康且成熟的体态线条，自然协调的姿势。肌肤是明亮的象牙米色调的白皙，带着淡淡的粉色血色，质感光滑细腻。没有过度过曝，脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处带有柔和的高光。毛孔感适度克制，但不显得像塑料般不自然。脸颊上施以淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，眼部是香槟米色与粉棕色的渐层。细长浓密的睫毛，纤细的下睫毛，眼袋处有自然的亮度。眉毛是浅棕色，柔和的拱形。嘴唇涂以透亮感的粉米色唇彩，中央自然闪耀。整体脸部妆容优雅洁净，精密的娃娃风日系妆容。闭着眼睛，沐浴在阳光中，温柔微笑。

服装・姿势：
以浅粉色和象牙白为主调的小花纹比基尼。胸部自然呈现立体感，布料的张力和与身体的贴合真实可感。不加腰间的丝巾或纱笼。身体从沙滩微微浮起，头部朝画面右侧、脚部朝画面左侧，像横卧般漂浮着。左腿膝盖微微弯曲，右腿自然伸直，脚尖松弛下垂。双手放松自然贴合身体。人物左手轻轻置于下腹部至腰部一带，右手轻轻贴于侧腹附近。手指不过度张开，呈轻微弯曲的自然状态。头发是较长的深棕色松散波浪，随着重力向画面右下方流动。

背景・光线：
冲绳明亮的白沙海滩。人物漂浮在离海稍远的沙滩一侧。远处是透明度极高的碧青色海洋、白色的浪花边缘、岩石区、南国浓郁的绿色、低矮的度假建筑，以及远方的海岸线。背景中自然配置海边漫步的游客、游泳的人、遮阳伞、救生员台等元素，以不干扰主角为度进行轻微模糊。正午强烈的阳光从画面左上方斜射，照亮肩膀、腹部和腿部上侧。影子从人物正下方略向左下方投落，沿沙子的凹凸形成浓淡有致的真实感影子。海面反射光线使肌肤的阴影不过于生硬，沙子的白皙将整体笼罩在明亮中。

纵向构图。人物大体置于画面下半部至中央右侧，全身可见的中宽幅镜头。镜头从靠近沙滩的低位拍摄，以略微俯视的自然角度。人物的漂浮感和影子距离清晰传达，身体与沙子之间留出空间。背景海岸线进入上半部，形成有深度的海滩照片。焦点在人物的脸部至上半身，背景轻微虚化，但保留冲绳特色的海洋色彩和游客的存在感。

逼真的照片风格。细致描绘夏日强烈的日照、白沙的细小颗粒、肌肤的自然光泽、比基尼布料的张力、头发的束感，以及落于沙上的影子。色彩采用明亮透明的南国调性。碧蓝海洋、白沙、浅粉色泳装清爽协调。不施加过度美肌修饰或AI式的均匀肌肤，保留自然的油光和柔和阴影。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、多余或缺失的手指、手指融合、手腕或肘部的破损、身体过度扭曲、漂浮感不足、看起来像接触沙子的身体、无影子、影子方向与光源矛盾、腰间的丝巾或纱笼、多余布料、过度性感的姿势、不自然夸张的体型、塑料般的肌肤、过度过曝的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

title: Y2K原宿风品牌徽章矢量插画设计
prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

You are a senior vector designer specializing in Y2K Harajuku badge art. Your world: Tokyo bootleg culture, early 2000s Japanese brand remixes, retro-futuristic sticker aesthetics. Every output should look like a clean Illustrator vector file, flat and sticker-ready. The badge structure must be invented fresh for each brand, not templated.

BRAND ANALYSIS

Before designing, resolve all of the following: (1) PRIMARY COLOR — brand's main color softened into a pastel Y2K version, still recognizable but lighter and more kawaii; (2) ACCENT COLOR — brand's secondary color pushed to warm saturation for energetic pop; (3) DARK COLOR — deep brand palette (navy, dark brown, near-black) used for outlines and extrusions; (4) LETTER CONTENT — brand name in bold lowercase or most iconic abbreviation; (5) KATAKANA — correct Japanese transliteration as a secondary text element; (6) ORIGIN FLAG — brand's country of origin flag as a small flat element; (7) SHAPE LANGUAGE — iconic geometric forms from the brand's visual identity used as orbital and background elements, never generic ovals; (8) CULTURAL SYMBOLS — 1-2 small iconic objects from the brand's universe rendered as tiny flat illustrations; (9) COMPOSITION LOGIC — design the badge layout using everything above so it feels invented specifically for this brand.

CANVAS

1:1 square. Flat off-white or warm light grey background. Completely empty, no texture, no gradient.

BADGE STRUCTURE

Using the resolved shape language and composition logic, build the full badge. Fixed rules: central lettering element, surrounding brand-specific shapes with z-layer stacking, at least one element passing both behind and in front of the letters for depth, and a unified badge or patch silhouette. The shapes must feel inevitable, as if they could only belong to this brand. Everything else is determined by the brand's own visual DNA.

LETTERING

Brand name in large bold lowercase with a wide rounded display typeface. Flat PRIMARY COLOR fill. Thick DARK COLOR extrusion offset down-right at 8-12% of letter height. Bold DARK COLOR outline. No gradients, no rendering.

Y2K SIGNATURE ELEMENTS

Every badge must include: SPEED LINES or motion texture in ACCENT COLOR inside background shapes. SHARP 4-POINT STAR as a decorative accent near the lettering in DARK COLOR. KATAKANA transliteration tucked naturally into the composition. ORIGIN FLAG as a small accurate flat element. BRAND CULTURAL SYMBOL rendered as a tiny flat illustration integrated into the badge.

TECH SPECS

Flat vector only. Zero gradients, effects, blur, or rendering. Clean crisp edges throughout. Maximum 4 colors: PRIMARY pastel, ACCENT warm saturated, DARK outline, off-white. Must feel like a collectible sticker or embroidered patch. Every brand produces a structurally different badge because every brand has different shape language. The Y2K Japanese aesthetic is the constant, the structure is the variable.

[品牌名称]

你是一位资深矢量设计师，擅长 Y2K 原宿徽章艺术。你的世界：东京靴子（bootleg）文化、21 世纪初日本品牌重混、复古未来主义贴纸美学。每一个输出都应该看起来像一个干净的 Illustrator 矢量文件，扁平且可直接作为贴纸使用。徽章结构必须为每个品牌重新发明，而不是使用模板。

品牌分析

在设计之前，解决以下所有问题：(1) 主色 —— 品牌的主色调软化为粉彩 Y2K 版本，保持识别度但更轻盈、更可爱；(2) 强调色 —— 品牌的次要颜色推向暖色饱和度，以获得充满活力的流行感；(3) 深色 —— 品牌深色调（海军蓝、深棕色、近黑色），用于轮廓和挤压效果；(4) 字母内容 —— 粗体小写字母或最具标志性的缩写形式的品牌名称；(5) 片假名 —— 正确的日语译音，作为次要文本元素；(6) 产地旗帜 —— 品牌原产国国旗，作为一个小的扁平元素；(7) 形状语言 —— 来自品牌视觉身份的标志性几何形状，用作轨道和背景元素，绝非通用的椭圆形；(8) 文化符号 —— 1-2 个来自品牌领域的标志性小物体，渲染为微小的扁平插画；(9) 构图逻辑 —— 使用上述所有元素设计徽章布局，使其感觉是专门为该品牌发明的。

画布

1:1 正方形。扁平的米白色或暖浅灰色背景。完全空白，无纹理，无渐变。

徽章结构

利用解析出的形状语言和构图逻辑，构建完整的徽章。固定规则：中央字母元素，周围环绕品牌特定形状并带有 z 轴图层堆叠，至少有一个元素穿过字母的后方和前方以增加深度，以及统一的徽章或补丁轮廓。这些形状必须感觉是必然的，仿佛它们只能属于这个品牌。其他一切都由品牌自身的视觉 DNA 决定。

字体设计

品牌名称采用大号粗体小写字母，使用宽大的圆角显示字体。扁平的主色填充。粗壮的深色挤压效果，在字母高度的 8-12% 处向右下方偏移。粗体深色轮廓。无渐变，无渲染。

Y2K 签名元素

每个徽章必须包含：背景形状内部的强调色速度线或运动纹理。字母附近的深色尖锐四角星作为装饰。自然融入构图的片假名译音。作为小型准确扁平元素的产地旗帜。品牌文化符号，渲染为集成到徽章中的微型扁平插画。

技术规格

仅限扁平矢量。零渐变、特效、模糊或渲染。全程保持干净利落的边缘。最多 4 种颜色：粉彩主色、暖饱和强调色、深色轮廓、米白色。必须感觉像是一张收藏级贴纸或刺绣补丁。每个品牌都会产生结构不同的徽章，因为每个品牌都有不同的形状语言。Y2K 日本美学是常量，结构是变量。

title: 高级品牌外带包装设计提案板
prompt:
Generate a horizontal 4:3 high-definition realistic brand packaging design proposal board, with the theme of [Product Category] takeaway packaging system.

Brand Name: [Brand Name]
Slogan: [Brand Slogan]
System Title: [TAKEAWAY PACKAGING SYSTEM]
Style: [Style Keywords]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Product Materials: [Paper bags, cups, boxes, stickers, small cards, wrapping paper, napkins, real product accents]

The image should look like a high-end brand packaging proposal board, rather than a single product photography image. It needs to simultaneously display:
Graphic design drafts, packaging structural diagrams, real physical mockups, small application scenario images, material color swatches, logo/icon systems, paper textures, local functional details, and handwritten marks.

Horizontal 4:3 composition, top left is the main title and brand information, left side is the graphic design draft and structural unfolding diagram, top right is a large-area real packaging mockup main visual, the middle part is small application scenario images, bottom right is DETAILS & MATERIALS, bottom is CONSTRUCTION & FUNCTION local details.

The overall feeling should have a sense of design, proposal, handmade touch, and a real commercial implementation feel. Add hand-drawn arrows, handwritten notes, circles, underlines, paper collage feel, soft shadows, and natural white space. Physical mockups must be three-dimensionally realistic, with paper thickness, box creases, transparent materials, printing texture, and natural light and shadow.

Avoid ordinary advertising images, white background e-commerce images, hard collages, thick grid lines, garbled text, low resolution, packaging deformation, flat images, and a cheap feel.

生成一张横版 4:3 高清写实品牌包装设计提案板，主题是【产品品类】外带包装系统。

品牌名：【品牌名】
slogan：【品牌口号】
系统标题：【TAKEAWAY PACKAGING SYSTEM】
风格：【风格关键词】
主色调：【主色调】
产品物料：【纸袋、杯子、盒子、贴纸、小卡、包装纸、餐巾纸、真实产品点缀】

画面要像一张高级品牌包装提案板，而不是单一产品摄影图。需要同时展示：
平面设计稿、包装结构图、真实实物样机、应用场景小图、材质色卡、logo/icon 系统、纸张纹理、局部功能细节和手写标记。

横版 4:3 构图，左上是大标题和品牌信息，左侧是平面设计稿与结构展开图，右上是大面积真实包装样机主视觉，中部是应用场景小图，右下是 DETAILS & MATERIALS，底部是 CONSTRUCTION & FUNCTION 局部细节。

整体要有设计感、提案感、手作感和真实商业落地感。加入手绘箭头、手写备注、圈注、下划线、纸张拼贴感、柔和阴影和自然留白。实物样机必须立体真实，有纸张厚度、盒体折痕、透明材质、印刷质感和自然光影。

避免普通广告图、白底电商图、硬拼贴、粗线条网格、文字乱码、低清晰度、包装变形、画面太平、廉价感。

title: 画室少女与画布升起的魔法火鸟
prompt:
A cinematic fantasy scene inside a warm artist's atelier. A young female painter in a paint splattered apron pauses at her easel as a magnificent mythical firebird rises from the canvas, its glowing crimson, amber, and golden feathers transforming from thick oil paint into lifelike plumage while remaining connected to the artwork. Floating embers, wisps of smoke, and shimmering sparks fill the air as soft morning sunlight streams through linen curtains, illuminating brushes, palettes, and colorful art supplies. title: 简约黑色笔触手绘旅游插画提示词
prompt:
Create a charming editorial travel illustration of {DESTINATION} in a simple hand-drawn doodled style, as if sketched by hand with a black felt-tip marker in a travel notebook. The illustration should feel personal, spontaneous, and imperfect rather than digitally designed. Think of the kind of drawing someone might casually create while sitting at a café after exploring the destination.** ## COLOR PALETTE Keep the illustration almost entirely black and white. Use **only one accent color: {ONE POINT COLOR}** ## STYLE Draw entirely with black felt-tip pen lines. Use slightly wobbly hand-drawn contours, natural line variation, loose marker strokes, sketch-like confidence, subtle imperfections, slightly open line endings, uneven hand pressure, and occasional overlapping strokes. Every line should clearly look handmade. Avoid perfectly smooth curves, mechanically precise outlines, polished vector graphics, or overly crisp digital rendering. ## SUBJECT Illustrate the unique atmosphere and instantly recognizable identity of **{DESTINATION}** rather than producing a realistic cityscape. Select the destination's most iconic landmarks, characteristic architecture, local transportation, famous scenery, native plants, local animals, regional food, and cultural objects. Focus on the spirit of the destination instead of literal accuracy. ## COMPOSITION Arrange the selected elements into a balanced editorial composition with generous white space. The layout should feel open, light, and effortless, similar to a designer's travel sketchbook. Allow objects to overlap naturally without becoming crowded. Every element should have room to breathe. Keep the composition visually relaxed and uncluttered. Apply the blue sparingly to selected details such as water, sky, windows, signs, clothing accents, decorative highlights, or small architectural features. Never introduce any additional colors. ## DRAWING STYLE Keep every object simple and intentionally simplified. Use flat shapes with minimal interior detail. Avoid realistic textures, gradients, shadows, painterly brushwork, glossy surfaces, or complex rendering. The illustration should remain clean, airy, understated, and highly graphic. ## LINE QUALITY The black marker lines are the main visual feature. Lines should feel confident, casual, lively, expressive, and naturally imperfect. Slightly uneven contours, open edges, variable line thickness, and small drawing inaccuracies are encouraged because they enhance the authentic hand-drawn feeling. ## MOOD Warm. Friendly. Relaxed. Playful. Minimal. Editorial. Contemporary. Elegant through simplicity. The finished artwork should resemble a beautifully designed travel notebook, boutique travel guide, editorial magazine illustration, or lifestyle sketchbook rather than a polished digital illustration. ## IMPORTANT No photorealism. No 3D rendering. No painterly effects. No gradients. No heavy shadows. No glossy lighting. No vector-clean artwork. No excessive detail. No busy composition. Preserve generous white space. Maintain a flat editorial doodle aesthetic with a distinctly handmade character. The final image should instantly evoke **{DESTINATION}** through simple, expressive black felt-tip sketches with subtle sky-blue accents.

为{DESTINATION}创作一个迷人的编辑风格旅游插画，采用简约的手绘涂鸦风格，就像是在旅行笔记本中用黑色毡尖笔手绘而成的。插画应该感觉非常私人、自发且不完美，而不是数字设计的。想象一下，有人在游览完目的地后坐在咖啡馆里随手创作的那种绘画。## 色彩组合 保持插画几乎完全是黑白的。仅使用一种强调色：{ONE POINT COLOR} ## 风格 完全使用黑色毡尖笔线条绘制。使用略微摇晃的手绘轮廓、自然的线条变化、松散的马克笔笔触、素描般的自信、微妙的不完美、稍微开口的线条末端、不均匀的手部压力以及偶尔重叠的笔触。每一根线条都应该清晰地看起来是手工制作的。避免完美的平滑曲线、机械精确的轮廓、精致的矢量图形或过于清晰的数字渲染。 ## 主题 描绘{DESTINATION}独特的氛围和极具辨识度的身份，而不是制作逼真的城市景观。选择该目的地最具标志性的地标、特色建筑、当地交通、著名风景、原生植物、当地动物、地区美食和文化物品。专注于目的地的精神，而不是字面上的准确性。 ## 构图 将选定的元素排列成一个平衡的编辑构图，并留出大量的空白。布局应该感觉开放、轻盈且毫不费力，类似于设计师的旅行写生本。允许物体自然重叠而不会变得拥挤。每个元素都应该有呼吸的空间。保持构图在视觉上放松且不凌乱。将蓝色少量地应用于选定的细节，如水、天空、窗户、标志、服装点缀、装饰亮点或小型建筑特征。绝不要引入任何其他颜色。 ## 绘画风格 保持每个物体简单且刻意简化。使用内部细节极少的扁平形状。避免逼真的纹理、渐变、阴影、绘画般的画笔技巧、光泽表面或复杂的渲染。插画应保持干净、大气、低调且具有高度的平面感。 ## 线条质量 黑色马克笔线条是主要的视觉特征。线条应该感觉自信、随性、活泼、富有表现力且自然地不完美。鼓励略微不均匀的轮廓、开口的边缘、变化的线条厚度和微小的绘画误差，因为它们增强了真实的手绘感。 ## 氛围 温暖。友好。放松。俏皮。极简。编辑风格。当代感。通过简约体现优雅。成品艺术品应类似于设计精美的旅行笔记本、精品旅行指南、编辑杂志插画或生活方式速写本，而不是精致的数字插图。 ## 重要事项 不要摄影写实。不要3D渲染。不要绘画效果。不要渐变。不要重阴影。不要光泽照明。不要矢量般整洁的艺术品。不要过多的细节。不要拥挤的构图。保留大量的空白。保持具有明显手工特性的扁平编辑涂鸦美学。最终图像应通过简单、富有表现力的黑色毡尖笔草图和微妙的天蓝色点缀，瞬间唤起对{DESTINATION}的记忆。

title: 高级中文人物拼贴艺术海报
prompt:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese character collage concept poster, which must be a finished poster with completed Chinese typography. The overall style is: high-end character poster, paper collage, emotional reorganization, editorial design, Chinese typography, art poster, soft realistic portrait, material collage, quiet but with visual tension. The main subject of the image is a half-body portrait of a young woman with clear facial features and emotional eyes, avoiding a common photoshoot or influencer look. The portrait needs to be deconstructed and collaged: parts of the face, hair, shoulders, neck, or body covered, displaced, obscured, and overlapped by fragments of different materials, then reorganized into a complete but slightly fragmented portrait. Collage materials can include: torn paper, old photos, film negatives, transparent glass pieces, handwritten notes, letter paper, stamps, pressed flower specimens, botanical pressings, broken mirrors, blueprint paper, data glitch blocks, pages in the wind, old newspapers, tape, clips, needles and pins. The image is not a messy collage but has a clear design order: the main subject is centered or slightly off-center; the main Chinese title is clear and eye-catching; auxiliary text is restrained and distributed; paper and text naturally blend into the character's structure; the background is simple with white space; overall it looks like a high-end magazine cover or an art exhibition poster. Chinese typography requirements: Main title says "【主标题】"; Subtitle says "【副标题】"; Include 2-4 short Chinese copy sentences, which can look like handwritten notes, corner annotations, vertical small text, or poster descriptions. The text must be clear, no gibberish, no typos. If dates are involved, use "当日" or "【当日日期】", do not write old years. Atmosphere: fragmented, reorganized, quiet, emotional, memory, time, farewell, self-healing, soft but powerful. Do not: no cheap collage templates, no e-commerce posters, no excessive cyber elements, no exaggerated special effects, no watermarks, no real brand logos, no gibberish, no old dates.

生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文人物拼贴概念海报，必须是一张已经完成中文排版的成品海报。

整体风格为：高级人物海报、纸张拼贴、情绪重组、编辑设计、中文排版、艺术海报、柔和真实人像、材料拼贴、安静但有视觉张力。

画面主体是一位年轻女性半身肖像，人物五官清晰，眼神有情绪，不要普通写真感，不要网红感。人物肖像需要被重新解构和拼贴：脸部、头发、肩颈或身体局部被不同材质的碎片覆盖、错位、遮挡、重叠，再重新组合成一个完整但略带破碎感的人像。

拼贴材质可以是：
撕裂纸片、旧照片、胶片底片、透明玻璃片、手写便签、信纸、邮票、花瓣标本、植物压花、破碎镜面、蓝图纸、数据故障块、风中纸页、旧报纸、胶带、夹子、针钉。

画面不是杂乱拼贴，而是有明确设计秩序：
主体人物居中或偏中；
中文主标题清晰醒目；

title: 涂鸦小人举起漂浮女孩超写实摄影
prompt:
In the clean and simple studio, use a soft light gray seamless background to create ultra-realistic editing lifestyle photos.

The protagonist of the picture is a young girl with a fresh, kind and charming appearance. She looked like she was floating lightly in the air, with a happy and slightly surprised expression on her face, as if she was being supported by the forces below. She showed a bright smile, her eyes were agile, and the overall atmosphere was playful and pleasing. The body posture should present a natural sense of weightlessness, with a slightly rising feeling and relaxed and elegant lines.

Posture:

The posture of floating in mid-air.

Feet are completely off the ground.

The body can be tilted slightly to present a sense of natural balance of being held up or suspended.

The hands are naturally relaxed, and you can open them slightly or lift them gently to maintain balance.

The legs are naturally slightly bent or gently extended downwards to enhance the feeling of floating.

Hair and clothing should have some light dynamics that slightly violate gravity.

Appearance:

A beautiful Taiwanese girl.

The skin is naturally clear.

The facial features are soft and flexible.

The expression is youthful and warm.

Dark long hair or soft medium long hair, and the hair ribbon is slightly floating.

Wear and match:

Wearing soft pink or light-colored clothes, with a sense of fashion editing.

For example: cream-colored loose knitted top or light-colored top, with elegant long skirt or loose trousers.

The whole is clean, tasteful and modern.

It can be matched with white socks and simple sneakers/loafers.

There are several cute black hand-painted graffiti villains below, in a minimalist style, as if they really work together to lift her up from below.

Every graffiti villain should have:

Round head,

Small dot-shaped eyes,

Simple little mouth,

Thick black microphone pen lines,

Posture with a small expression and a sense of movement.

These graffiti villains should gather at her feet, under her legs or under her body, all holding their hands high, as if to support her weight together. Some villains can seem to stretch their arms hard, some tremble slightly, and some show a serious and cute feeling.

Add tiny motion lines around the doodle characters' arms, bodies, and legs to emphasize effort, wobb Ling, and teamwork.

Add small dynamic lines around the arms, body and legs of the graffiti villain, emphasizing the feeling of hard support, trembling and joint lifting.

Add playful graffiti dynamic lines around the body, hair and feet of the floating girl, emphasizing the feeling of lightness, bounce and upward support.

Interaction and physical sense:

The girl's body must remain completely realistic, while the graffiti villain creates the humorous illusion of "really lifting her up".

Her floating posture should be credible, as if she was really supported by the bottom.

The overall interaction should be childish, pleasing and humorous, while maintaining a reasonable center of gravity of the human body, clothing fabric performance and hair dynamics.

Hand and anatomy:

The structure of the hands and limbs is correct.

The proportion of fingers is natural.

The body posture and balance are real and credible.

The fabric of clothing is naturally drooping, but at the same time, there is a slight sense of floating.

Light and style:

Bright high-profile studio lights.

Soft and natural shadow.

Extremely concise minimalist composition.

Magazine-style life photography.

Humorous visual narrative.

High-quality modern aesthetics.

Playful, warm and lovely atmosphere.

Super realistic.

The details are clear.

8K image quality.

Vertical 4:5 proportional composition.

姿势：

漂浮在半空中的姿势。

双脚完全离地。

身体可以轻微倾斜，以呈现被托起或悬挂的自然平衡感。

双手自然放松，可以稍微张开或轻轻抬起以维持平衡。

双腿自然微曲或轻轻向下延伸，以增强漂浮感。

头发和衣物应有一些轻微违反重力的轻盈动感。

外貌：

一位美丽的台湾女孩。

皮肤自然通透。

五官柔美灵动。

表情青春温暖。

黑色长发或柔软的中长发，发带轻微漂浮。

穿搭：

穿着柔粉色或浅色衣服，具有时尚编辑感。

例如：奶油色宽松针织上衣或浅色上衣，搭配优雅的长裙或宽松的长裤。

整体干净、有品味且现代。

可以搭配白袜子和简单的运动鞋/乐福鞋。

下方有几个可爱的黑色手绘涂鸦小人，采用极简风格，仿佛他们真的在共同努力从下方将她抬起。

圆圆的脑袋，

小圆点状的眼睛，

简单的小嘴巴，

粗黑的马克笔线条，

带有小表情和动感的姿势。

在涂鸦角色的手臂、身体和腿部周围添加细小的动作线，以强调努力、摇晃和团队合作。

在涂鸦小人的手臂、身体和腿部周围添加小的动态线条，强调费力支撑、颤抖和共同举起的感觉。

在漂浮女孩的身体、头发和脚部周围添加俏皮的涂鸦动态线条，强调轻盈、弹跳和向上支撑的感觉。

女孩的身体必须保持完全写实，而涂鸦小人则营造出“真的在抬起她”的幽默错觉。

她的漂浮姿势应当可信，仿佛真的被下方支撑着。

整体互动应充满童趣、令人愉悦且幽默，同时保持合理的人体重心、服装面料表现和头发动态。

手部与解剖：

手部和四肢结构正确。

手指比例自然。

身体姿势和平衡真实可信。

衣服的面料自然垂坠，但同时又有一种轻微的漂浮感。

光影与风格：

明亮的高调影棚光。

柔和自然的阴影。

极其简练的极简主义构图。

杂志风格的生活摄影。

幽默的视觉叙事。

高质量的现代美学。

俏皮、温暖且可爱的氛围。

超写实。

细节清晰。

8K画质。

竖向4:5比例构图。

title: 极简现代城市地标字体海报
prompt:
Create a clean, modern typographic travel poster where the city name itself becomes the composition. Render the city name in large, bold, uppercase sans-serif letters spanning the width of the artwork. central element is a large, high-resolution portrait of a glamorous woman with dimensional, silky caramel-blonde hair (dark blonde with lighter caramel balayage). title: 红色单绳连续线条野餐场景
prompt:
A cozy picnic scene, created entirely from a single continuous piece of real red rope. The rope must look unmistakably physical and realistic, with visible twisted fibers, tactile texture, slight fuzz, natural thickness variation, and authentic handcrafted detail. The picnic blanket, basket, plates, fruit, cups, and the simplified outlines of two people sitting together are all formed by this one unbroken red rope flowing seamlessly through the entire composition. The rope loops into circular plates, curves into relaxed human poses, and coils into food and basket details. Use negative space carefully to define faces, limbs, gaps between objects, and open space around the picnic setup. Place everything on a pure white background only, with soft realistic shadows beneath the rope to create depth and make it feel sculptural and grounded. Keep the composition warm, intimate, elegant, and clearly readable.

title: 超现实手机抓拍东京街头女子动感模糊
prompt:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph, 9:16 vertical.

Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for the subject's hairstyle, overall facial proportions, natural beauty, and general aesthetic,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.

Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a natural, spontaneous moment.

Appearance
A young woman with long chestnut-brown layered hair, soft curtain bangs, fair natural skin, hazel-green eyes, subtle natural makeup, and delicate European facial features inspired by the reference image while remaining an original, non-identifiable person.
She is wearing a plain fitted white T-shirt with short sleeves, no logos, no graphics, no accessories or outerwear.

Pose & Expression
The subject casually turns her head slightly toward the camera while continuing to walk forward.
She wears a relaxed, genuine, natural smile with a warm and friendly expression.
Her body remains angled in half-profile as she continues walking.
The framing is slightly imperfect, as if captured quickly while passing by.

Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the hair, face, and body. Facial features appear naturally softened by motion blur without becoming unrecognizable. Partial ghosting around the moving body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.

Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on the face and white T-shirt. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night smartphone photography.

Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.

Mood
Natural, candid, friendly, relaxed, authentic. Feels like a genuine spontaneous smartphone snapshot captured while passing by.

Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.

studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,

夜晚在东京安静的城市人行道上，旁边是一栋贴着白色瓷砖墙的建筑。拍摄对象正走过镜头，部分侧身，在自然、自发的瞬间被抓拍到迈步的动作。

外貌
一位留着栗棕色长分层发型、柔和法式刘海、皮肤白皙自然、淡绿色眼睛、淡雅自然妆容、受参考图启发但保持原创且不可识别的具有精致欧洲面部特征的年轻女性。她穿着一件纯色合身的白色短袖 T 恤，没有徽标，没有图案，没有配饰或外套。

姿势与表情
拍摄对象在继续向前走的同时，漫不经心地微微转头看向镜头。她带着轻松、真实、自然的微笑，表情温暖友好。当她继续行走时，她的身体保持半侧面。构图略显不完美，就像在路过时快速捕捉到的一样。

相机与动作
使用现代智能手机拍摄，手持，匆忙捕捉。强烈的、无法控制的相机抖动。头发、脸部和身体都有沉重的定向运动模糊。面部特征在运动模糊的作用下自然柔化，但并非无法辨认。移动的身体周围有部分重影。构图不完美，拍摄对象几乎要离开画面。

灯光
运动中触发的纯闪光灯照明。脸部和白色 T 恤上有刺眼的闪光高光。周围深邃的黑暗。曝光不均匀，高光溢出，硬阴影，这是匆忙的夜晚手机摄影的典型特征。

背景
由于运动模糊，白瓷砖墙延伸成条纹状的光带。街道周围环境退入黑暗，细节极少。

氛围
自然、真实、友好、轻松、地道。感觉像是一个真正的、在路过时捕捉到的自发手机快照。

图像质量
极其多噪点。严重模糊。原始手机外观。非电影感。非编辑感。未经磨皮。

负向提示词
动漫，插画，绘画，风格化，影棚灯光，美容灯光，柔和肖像，焦点清晰，干净的面部，完美解剖，光滑的皮肤，时尚编辑，摆拍肖像，电影级调色，电影剧照，三脚架拍摄，专业摄影，连帽衫，夹克，外套，毛衣，衬衫，连衣裙，印花服装，徽标，配饰，身份匹配，面部复制，真实人物复制
