title: 悬浮圆片装置艺术中文海报设计
prompt:
Please generate a vertical 3:4 finished Chinese poster.

Referencing the visual logic of "suspended circular disc installation spaces": a large number of circular and elliptical discs suspended in a high-ceilinged space, floating in layers, with a strong sense of spatial depth, repetitive rhythm, and installation art.

But do not simply replicate the original image; perform major modifications and redesigns. Retain the core characteristics of "suspended discs / layered floating / spatial envelopment," while significantly reconstructing the thematic concept, material language, light and shadow atmosphere, color system, composition method, and layout structure to make it a brand-new poster work.

【Poster Theme】
Theme Direction: {fill in theme direction}
Main Title: {fill in Chinese title}
Subtitle: {can fill in a short sentence, or leave blank}

【Visual Requirements】
- The main subject of the image is a large number of floating discs / circular plates / translucent flakes / luminous media / material units
- These circular elements should form a clear spatial structure and rhythm, with a sense of immersion, envelopment, and suspension
- The scene can be reset as: future exhibition, dream space, moon phase installation, data interface, sound resonance field, microscopic ecology, memory slices, optical experimental field, time sample library, etc.
- Must have a clear "poster feel," not just a spatial rendering
- Composition can vary boldly: top-down view, worm's-eye view, central perspective, off-axis composition, negative space composition, partial cropping are all acceptable
- Emphasize material changes: metal, translucent film, glass, paper, matte acrylic, luminous film, mirror surface, fiber, etc.
- Light and shadow should have emotion, could be dreamy, restrained, mysterious, futuristic, quiet, or experimental

【Layout Requirements】
- Must be a complete Chinese typography finished poster
- Chinese title is clear and has a sense of design
- Can add a small amount of English auxiliary information, but Chinese is primary
- Can add exhibition information, location, descriptions, and other small text information, overall resembling a real exhibition poster
- If the image involves date or time information, do not write a specific old year; use "Today" or do not write a specific date
- Typography should integrate with the image, not look like crudely pasted text
- Style is high-end, restrained, clean, with the temperament of an art poster or design exhibition poster

【Style Keywords】
Minimalist exhibition poster, installation art visual, contemporary design poster, spatial installation, Chinese typography, artistic sense, negative space, material contrast, immersive atmosphere, visual experiment

No watermarks, no logos, no gibberish, no low-quality fonts, no cheap e-commerce feel.

title: 墙上的熊与夏日巷子里的少女
prompt:
Subject:
Bear on the wall and summer alley

Character/Expression:
A female in her 20s. Bright and healthy atmosphere, with natural fair skin shining in the sunlight. Soft face, long straight black hair lightly tied in a half-ponytail, with fine bangs on the forehead and stray hairs gently swaying in the wind. The makeup is a translucent natural Japanese style, with slightly flushed cheeks and a natural lip color with suppressed gloss. Looking back at the camera with a bright smile full of openness. The expression is a mix of surprise and joy.

Clothing/Pose:
A light ice blue summer top. An asymmetric off-the-shoulder design with the right shoulder naturally exposed, and a lightweight style with one sleeve slightly baggy. The bottom is a white flowing long skirt, made of thin, lightweight fabric that flares out significantly while walking. On her feet are white sneakers. The woman is in the moment of running forward lightly, her upper body turned toward the direction of travel, with only her face looking back. One arm is slightly bent forward, and the back of the other sleeve is being pulled. The left leg is slightly raised backward, with the hem of the skirt swaying dynamically.

Background/Lighting:
A sunny afternoon alley. On the left side of the frame is a continuous concrete wall, covered with colorful graffiti. The main graffiti is a soft light blue bear character. It has large round eyes, pink cheeks, a pink bow on its head, and is wearing pink shorts, giving a gentle and cute impression overall. The character is drawn entirely as wall graffiti, not three-dimensional, and does not jump out from the wall. Only the bear's hand is in a trompe-l'oeil composition as if it is pulling the woman's clothing. Surrounded by pop decorations like hearts, stars, flowers, and paint splashes. The lighting is soft summer sunlight pouring from the upper right, illuminating the woman's face, shoulders, and the front of her skirt, casting natural shadows at her feet. The depth of the alley in the background is slightly blurred, moderately integrating the atmosphere of utility poles and buildings.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. A full-body street portrait. The woman is positioned off-center to the right of the frame, while the graffiti bear is prominently placed on the wall on the left side, clearly showing the "clothes being pulled" relationship through the sense of distance between the two. A natural perspective close to waist height, shot from a slight angle along the alley. Captures the woman's body movements and the flow of the skirt from a medium distance. The face is clearly in focus, with the background slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Realistic Japanese street snap photo. Utilizes the bright and refreshing texture of summer using natural light. The skin is smooth but not over-edited, detailing the tension of the clothing fabric and the transparency of the skirt. The rough texture of the wall, the bleeding of the paint, and the overlapping of colors are all presented one by one. Overall clean and refreshing, with a high level of completion where pop and cute graffiti harmoniously coexist with lightweight portrait photography.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, overly childish face, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, extra or missing fingers, deformed hands and feet, unnatural joints, gravity distortion, unnatural way clothing is pulled, unnatural skirt flare, three-dimensional representation of wall characters, characters jumping out of the wall, scary-looking graffiti, excessively vibrant chromatic aberration, extra people, readable text, logos, watermarks.

主题：
墙上的熊和夏日的巷子

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮健康的氛围，在阳光下闪耀的自然白皙肌肤。脸庞柔和，黑长直发轻轻扎成半马尾，前额细刘海和后逸发丝随风微微摇曳。妆容是透亮感的日系自然妆，脸颊微微泛红，唇部是抑制光泽的自然色泽。回头看向镜头，带着开阔感的明亮笑容。表情中混杂着惊讶与愉悦。

服装・姿势：
淡冰蓝色的夏日上衣。右肩自然露出的不对称露肩设计，一侧袖子微微松垮的轻盈款式。下装是白色轻盈的长裙，薄透的轻质面料在行走时大幅展开。脚上是白色运动鞋。女性处于向前轻快奔跑的瞬间，上半身朝前进方向转动，唯独脸庞回头张望。一只手臂微微向前弯曲，另一侧袖子的后方被拉扯着。左腿微微向后抬起，裙摆随之荡起动感。

背景・光线：
晴朗午后的巷弄。画面左侧是绵延的混凝土墙壁，墙面布满多彩涂鸦。主角涂鸦是偏柔和的浅蓝色熊角色。大大的圆眼睛，粉红的脸颊，头顶粉色蝴蝶结，穿着粉色短裤，整体给人温柔可爱的印象。角色完全作为墙面涂鸦绘制，不立体化，也不从墙上跃出。只有熊的手仿佛拽着女性衣摆的错视构图。周围点缀着心形、星星、花朵、颜料飞溅般的流行装饰。光线是从右上方洒下的柔和夏日阳光，照亮女性的脸庞、肩膀和裙子前部，脚下投下自然的阴影。背景巷子深处略微虚化，适度融入电线杆和建筑物的气息。

构图・镜头：
纵向构图。全身入镜的街头肖像。女性位于画面右侧偏位，涂鸦熊则大面积配置在画面左侧的墙面上，通过两者距离感明确展现“衣物被拉扯”的关系。镜头接近腰部高度的自然视角，从略微斜角沿巷子拍摄。中距离捕捉女性的身体动作和裙摆流动。脸部清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化。

质感・风格：
真实的日系街头抓拍照片。活用自然光的明亮清爽夏日质感。肌肤平滑却不过度修饰，细致描绘衣物布料的张力和裙子的轻透感。墙面的粗糙纹理、颜料的晕染、色彩的重叠也一一呈现。整体干净清爽，流行可爱的涂鸦与轻盈的人物摄影和谐共存的完成度。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、过于幼稚的脸庞、过度美肌修正、塑料般的肌肤、多余或缺失的手指、手脚变形、不自然的关节、重力失真、衣物拉扯方式的不自然、裙子展开的不自然、墙上角色立体化的表现、从墙上跃出的角色、可怕表情的涂鸦、过度艳丽的色差、多余人物、可读文字、标志、水印。

20多岁的女性。明亮健康的氛围，在阳光下闪耀的自然白皙肌肤。脸庞柔和，黑长直发轻轻扎成半马尾，前额细刘海和后逸发丝随风微微摇曳。妆容是透亮感的日系自然妆，脸颊微微泛红，唇部是抑制光泽的自然色泽。回头看向镜头，带着开阔感的明亮笑容。表情中混杂着惊讶与愉悦。

服装・姿势：
淡冰蓝色的夏日上衣。右肩自然露出的不对称露肩设计，一侧袖子微微松垮的轻盈款式。下装是白色轻盈的长裙，薄透的轻质面料在行走时大幅展开。脚上是白色运动鞋。女性处于向前轻快奔跑的瞬间，上半身朝前进方向转动，唯独脸庞回头张望。一只手臂微微向前弯曲，另一侧袖子的后方被拉扯着。左腿微微向后抬起，裙摆随之荡起动感。

背景・光线：
晴朗午后的巷弄。画面左侧是绵延的混凝土墙壁，墙面布满多彩涂鸦。主角涂鸦是偏柔和的浅蓝色熊角色。大大的圆眼睛，粉红的脸颊，头顶粉色蝴蝶结，穿着粉色短裤，整体给人温柔可爱的印象。角色完全作为墙面涂鸦绘制，不立体化，也不从墙上跃出。只有熊的手仿佛拽着女性衣摆的错视构图。周围点缀着心形、星星、花朵、颜料飞溅般的流行装饰。光线是从右上方洒下的柔和夏日阳光，照亮女性的脸庞、肩膀和裙子前部，脚下投下自然的阴影。背景巷子深处略微虚化，适度融入电线杆和建筑物的气息。

纵向构图。全身入镜的街头肖像。女性位于画面右侧偏位，涂鸦熊则大面积配置在画面左侧的墙面上，通过两者距离感明确展现“衣物被拉扯”的关系。镜头接近腰部高度的自然视角，从略微斜角沿巷子拍摄。中距离捕捉女性的身体动作和裙摆流动。脸部清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化。

真实的日系街头抓拍照片。活用自然光的明亮清爽夏日质感。肌肤平滑却不过度修饰，细致描绘衣物布料的张力和裙子的轻透感。墙面的粗糙纹理、颜料的晕染、色彩的重叠也一一呈现。整体干净清爽，流行可爱的涂鸦与轻盈的人物摄影和谐共存的完成度。

title: 微型动作累积成宏大质量等轴测3D渲染
prompt:
Create a clean but dramatic 3D render showing how tiny repeated actions related to [TOPIC] accumulate into an overwhelming mass. The AI should choose a micro-action: clicks, likes, searches, swipes, bottles opened, emails sent, seconds watched, bags thrown away, calories consumed, miles driven, photos taken, or transactions made.  Represent each micro-action as one tiny unit: pebble, tile, bead, paper slip, droplet, cube, coin, pixel, capsule, or brick. Show millions or billions of these units forming an avalanche, dune, pile, wave, dam, cliff, or landfill-like sculpture. A single ordinary unit should appear in the foreground so the viewer understands the scale jump.  Style: isometric 3D, tactile matte materials, soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, neutral background, minimal clutter. Include one huge numeral, a small human silhouette, and one caption explaining the accumulation period and source year.  The spirit: make the viewer feel how small actions become planetary-scale objects.

prompt:

title: 高明度线描群像平面图形海报
prompt:
Generate a high-key graphic poster based on any subject: The upper half of the image establishes a dense and orderly array of line-drawn group portraits or similar symbols. All elements are repeatedly arranged with thin black lines, simplified facial features, or geometric outlines, forming a rhythm similar to a wall of people; in this homogeneous repetition, set a clear thematic focus. The focus does not win by complex realism but is recognized at a glance through small-area theme-derived accent colors, slight contrast, local blank space, or morphological differences, creating a visual moment of "suddenly being seen among many similar individuals." Below, a large quiet information area is reserved. The main title uses heavy, compact, low-center-of-gravity black block characters. The typeface has a poster printing feel and strong weight. Auxiliary text forms a rational explanatory layer with small font sizes, neat line spacing, and clear alignment. Image density and text white space form an upper-lower contrast. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and semantics of the subject itself, without copying fixed color numbers: a large area of background serves as a bright and clean structural base color, occupying the main visual area; black or dark lines bear the order, text, and information skeleton; a small amount of high-saturation theme accent color falls only on key focal points or necessary details, with a restrained area but striking position. The overall style remains transparent, light, and clean with a high-key temperament, clear edges, uniform lines, and simple color levels, avoiding stacked shadows, dirty textures, and realistic impurities, so that the subject is quickly remembered through repetitive arrays, single-point differences, and steady text weight.

title: 圣托里尼悬崖小镇优雅扁平矢量插画
prompt:
Design an elegant minimalist destination illustration in a contemporary flat-vector editorial style with a calm, sophisticated atmosphere. Capture a sweeping coastal panorama of Santorini, showcasing sunlit whitewashed villages perched on rugged cliffs, iconic azure domed chapels, winding stone pathways, cascading terraces, blooming bougainvillea, crystal-clear Mediterranean waters, graceful sailing boats, and striking volcanic coastlines stretching into the distance. Small groups of visitors wander peaceful alleyways, relax at open-air cafés, paint scenic views, capture photographs, and quietly enjoy the seaside landscape.

Use a harmonious palette of warm ivory, soft azure, pale sand, muted sage, dusty terracotta, and gentle seafoam tones. Build the scene with simplified geometric forms, fine illustrated details, soft tonal transitions, layered atmospheric perspective, and generous negative space to create a refined, airy composition. Arrange the artwork in a vertical poster layout with balanced foreground, middle distance, and horizon, emphasizing tranquility, openness, and timeless Mediterranean charm. Produce an ultra clean, high end vector illustration with crisp edges, subtle texture, soft natural illumination, and exceptional detail suitable for a premium travel editorial or gallery quality print. Ensure the artwork contains no text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, signage, or watermarks anywhere in the image.

设计一张优雅极简的目的地插画，采用当代扁平矢量社论风格，营造出宁静、精致的氛围。捕捉圣托里尼壮阔的海岸全景，展示坐落在崎岖悬崖上阳光照耀的白色村庄、标志性的蔚蓝圆顶教堂、蜿蜒的石路、层叠的露台、盛开的三角梅、清澈见底的地中海海水、优美的帆船以及延伸至远方的壮丽火山海岸线。一小群游客在宁静的巷弄中漫步，在露天咖啡馆放松，写生风景，拍照，并静静地欣赏海滨美景。使用由暖象牙色、柔和蔚蓝色、浅沙色、柔和鼠尾草绿、灰土红色和温柔的海沫色组成的和谐调色板。利用简化的几何形状、精细的插画细节、柔和的色调过渡、分层的空气透视和大量的负空间来构建场景，创造出精致、轻盈的构图。将作品排列为垂直海报布局，平衡前景、中景和地平线，强调宁静、开放和永恒的地中海魅力。制作一张极其干净、高端的矢量插画，具有锐利的边缘、细微的纹理、柔和的自然光照和卓越的细节，适用于高级旅游社论或画廊品质的印刷。确保作品在图像的任何地方都不包含文本、字母、数字、标志、符号、标牌或水印。

title: 浪漫城市夏日水彩素描旅行海报
prompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical watercolor urban sketch travel poster on textured handmade watercolor paper.

City input:
[CITY NAME]

Create a romantic everyday scene reflecting the real architecture, landmarks, street life, climate, and cultural mood of [CITY NAME]. Use recognizable city-specific elements such as local buildings, cafes, balconies, canals, bridges, trams, towers, rooftops, tiles, waterfronts, street furniture, plants, or signs. Avoid generic European scenery or incorrect landmarks.

Main scene:
Show two lovers as the main subjects, placed slightly below center. They may be walking, sitting at an outdoor cafe, sharing iced coffee, standing near the water, looking at a view, or gently holding hands. Their pose should feel natural, affectionate, quiet, and unposed. Do not show a single person.

Characters:
Dress the couple in stylish casual summer clothing suited to [CITY NAME]: linen shirts, light cardigans, relaxed trousers, summer dresses, sneakers, sandals, sunglasses, crossbody bags, tote bags, cameras, pastries, or iced drinks. Use mostly white, pale blue, aqua, and soft gray-blue clothing with one or two small lemon-yellow accents. Add gentle wind movement to hair and loose fabric.

Composition:
Use a clean vertical poster layout with large negative space and an airy editorial feel. Keep the couple small to medium in scale, framed by city-specific architecture or scenery. Place buildings and landmarks in the background or along the sides, softly blended into the paper texture. Keep the upper half bright and open, with the upper right reserved for typography.

Typography:
In the upper right corner, add the city name in elegant italic English lettering:
"[CITY NAME]"

Directly below, add one short poetic English sentence matching the city's fresh summer mood. Use delicate soft cobalt, gray-blue, or muted navy lettering. Keep it minimal, readable, and naturally integrated into the paper.

Color direction:
Use a refreshing blue-and-yellow summer palette:

75% cool blues and blue-grays: sky blue, cyan, pale aqua, powder blue, faded turquoise, soft blue-gray, selective cobalt.

15% clean white and warm off-white paper highlights.

10% pale lemon yellow, soft butter yellow, sunlit cream, or light golden accents.

Blue should dominate while yellow adds warmth and visual rhythm. Use yellow only as accents in awnings, window light, flowers, umbrellas, pastries, signs, clothing details, drink labels, or sunlit building edges. Avoid an all-blue flat background.

Watercolor technique:

prompt:
Generate a vertical 3:4 artistic poster; it must be a finished poster with typography already completed.

The theme is [Fill in Theme]. The overall style is not ordinary ocean photography or ordinary fish illustrations, but a conceptual poster with strong emotional temperament, a sense of dreams, atmosphere, and a sense of design.

[Core Visuals]
The image features [schools of fish / jellyfish / tropical fish / glowing fish / translucent marine life / floating objects / sea surface light and shadow] as the main subject, but they must undergo significant modification. Do not replicate realistically; transform them into visuals with more visual impact and artistic sense.
Can include:
Hazy mist, gradient seawater, floating particles, soft focus, halo, slight grain, blurred edges, dreamcore atmosphere, low-contrast background, ethereal negative space, floating composition, poetic visual narrative.

[Composition Requirements]
The image must have a clear visual focus. You can use:
Large areas of negative space, offset composition, floating layout, poster-like cropping, distinct top and bottom layers, rhythmic density of the subject, local magnification, contrast between near and far, single-side title typography, corner information typography.
Do not make it like an ordinary wallpaper; make it like a real design poster.

[Color and Atmosphere]
The overall color scheme revolves around [Fill in Main Color, e.g., coral orange, mist pink, sea salt blue, deep sea black, neon purple, grey-green, amber gold].
The tones should be unified, soft, and have a sense of air. It can have a bit of film grain, matte texture, and a slight printing feel.
Atmosphere keywords: quiet, ethereal, sentimental, healing, blurred, dreamy, surreal, poetic.

[Typography]
Add complete Chinese typography to the image.
The main title says: [Fill in Chinese Main Title]
The subtitle says: [Fill in a short copy sentence]
Auxiliary small text says:
[Fill in small text 1]
[Fill in small text 2]
[Fill in small text 3]

Typography should be restrained and high-end. No advertising feel, no clutter, no long manual-style text.
Can be paired with a small amount of English small text as auxiliary information, but primarily in Chinese.
No real brand names, no watermarks, no garbled text, no expired dates.
If a date is needed, do not automatically write the year; leave it blank or weaken it.

[Visual Texture]
High-end artistic poster texture, soft focus photography feel, dreamy ocean atmosphere, with printing grain and modern design sense.
The subject should be clear but edges can be softened. Avoid clutter, deformity, low quality, and cheap special effects.

Output as: A complete finished poster, clear Chinese, typography finished.

生成一张竖版 3:4 的艺术海报，必须是一张已经完成排版的成品海报。

主题为【填写主题】，整体不是普通海洋摄影，也不是普通鱼类插画，而是一张带有强烈情绪气质、梦境感、氛围感和设计感的概念海报。

【核心画面】
画面以【鱼群 / 水母 / 热带鱼 / 发光鱼 / 半透明海洋生物 / 漂浮物 / 海面光影】为主体，但必须进行大幅度魔改，不要写实复刻，要转化成更有视觉冲击力和艺术感的画面。
可以加入：
朦胧雾气、渐变色海水、漂浮微粒、柔焦、光晕、轻微颗粒、模糊边缘、梦核氛围、低对比背景、空灵留白、漂浮感构图、诗性画面叙事。

【构图要求】
画面要有明确的视觉重心，可以采用：
大面积留白、偏置构图、漂浮式布局、海报感裁切、上下层次分明、主体疏密有节奏、局部放大、远近对比、单侧标题排版、角落信息排版。
不要做成普通壁纸，要像真正的设计海报。

【色彩与氛围】
整体配色围绕【填写主色，例如珊瑚橙、雾粉、海盐蓝、深海黑、霓虹紫、灰绿色、琥珀金】展开。
色调统一、柔和、有空气感，可以带一点胶片颗粒、雾面质感和轻微印刷感。
氛围关键词：安静、空灵、伤感、治愈、迷离、梦幻、超现实、诗意。

【文字排版】
画面中加入完整中文排版。
主标题写：【填写中文主标题】
副标题写：【填写一句短文案】
辅助小字写：
【填写小字1】
【填写小字2】
【填写小字3】

文字排版要克制高级，不要广告感，不要杂乱，不要大段说明书式文本。
可搭配少量英文小字作为辅助信息，但中文为主。
不要出现真实品牌名，不要出现水印，不要出现错误乱码，不要出现过期日期。
如果需要日期，不要自动写年份，留空或弱化处理。

【画面质感】
高级艺术海报质感，柔焦摄影感，梦幻海洋氛围，带印刷颗粒和现代设计感。
主体清晰但边缘可柔化，避免脏乱、畸形、低质感、廉价特效感。

输出为：完整成品海报，中文清晰，排版完成。

9:16 vertical composition, high-end Korean editorial studio portrait, soft-focus CCD aesthetic, dreamy haze, strong highlight bloom, halation glow, visible fine film grain, slightly overexposed highlights, creamy warm tone, shallow depth of field.

Scene: minimalist private studio set, beige/ivory seamless backdrop, soft draped fabric in background, controlled diffused studio lighting with gentle side fill, creating soft shadows and glowing skin texture.

Subject: young adult Taiwanese woman, short pastel pink bob hair, slightly messy and airy, fashionable idol-like presence.

Expression & vibe: cold, confident “bad girl / cool boss girl” energy, slightly raised chin, direct eye contact with camera, minimal emotion but highly controlled attitude.

Pose: close-up portrait framing (chest-up to tight close-up). One finger placed vertically in front of lips making a “ shh” gesture. Lips slightly parted, emphasis on sensual silence and attitude. Face angled slightly toward camera for dimensional lighting.

Makeup: Korean-style glass skin makeup, dewy luminous base, soft peach-pink blush, subtle contour, clean straight brows, soft brown eyeliner, long separated lashes, inner-eye highlight. Lip makeup is the focal point: glossy gradient lips (Korean ombré lip), high shine, hydrated texture, sharp focus on lip detail.

Wardrobe: elegant studio lingerie-inspired styling (tasteful, non-explicit), ivory silk camisole or off-shoulder soft robe, delicate straps visible, soft fabric texture catching light.

Lighting: soft diffused key light from side, gentle backlight creating halo around hair, specular highlights on lips and nose bridge, dreamy bloom around highlights.

Camera style: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, focus locked on eyes + lips, cinematic editorial magazine look, ultra-detailed skin texture, soft blur in background.

Mood keywords: cool, silent, intimate, high-fashion, expensive, minimalist luxury, Korean magazine cover, editorial silence moment.

9:16 垂直构图，高端韩国社论工作室人像，软焦 CCD 美学，梦幻薄雾，强光晕染，晕光辉光，可见的细腻胶片颗粒，略微过曝的高光，奶油色暖色调，浅景深。

场景：极简私人工作室布景，米色/象牙色无缝背景，背景中柔软的垂坠织物，受控的漫反射工作室照明，带有柔和的侧向补光，营造出柔和的阴影和发光的皮肤纹理。

主体：成年台湾年轻女性，短款浅粉色波波头，略显凌乱且轻盈，时尚偶像般的存在感。

表情与氛围：冷酷、自信的“坏女孩/酷飒女老板”能量，微抬下巴，与摄像机直接目光接触，情感极少但态度高度受控。

姿势：特写人像构图（从胸部向上到紧凑特写）。一根手指垂直放在嘴唇前，做出“嘘”的手势。双唇微启，强调感官的沉默和态度。脸部稍微向摄像机倾斜，以获得立体光效。

妆容：韩式玻璃肌妆容，水润透亮底妆，柔和的桃粉色腮红，微妙的修容，干净的平直眉，柔和的棕色眼线，纤长根根分明的睫毛，眼角提亮。唇妆是重点：光泽渐变唇（韩式咬唇），高光泽，水润质感，锐利聚焦嘴唇细节。

服装：优雅的工作室内衣灵感造型（大方，非露骨），象牙色丝绸吊带裙或一字肩柔软长袍，可见精致肩带，柔软的面料纹理捕捉光线。

光影：来自侧面的柔和漫射主光，营造头发周围光晕的柔和背光，嘴唇和鼻梁上的镜面高光，高光周围的梦幻晕染。

相机风格：85mm 人像镜头，浅景深，焦点锁定在眼睛 + 嘴唇，电影感社论杂志外观，极尽细腻的皮肤纹理，背景柔和模糊。

情绪关键词：酷，寂静，亲密，高级时尚，昂贵，极简奢华，韩国杂志封面，社论沉默时刻。

title: 纸上成真戏韵妆造设定稿实景视觉
prompt:
Generate a "Paper Comes True · Opera Makeup and Costume Design" style image, 4:5 vertical version.

The theme is [Beijing Opera Huadan / Daomadan / Kunqu Water Sleeves / Drunken Concubine]. The scene is an off-white opera makeup design manuscript paper clipped to a wooden drawing board, placed on a warm wood-colored workbench. A realistic adult Chinese female naturally rises from the paper, forming a "Paper Comes True" visual effect.

The character is in a mostly half-body composition, with a clear face and large proportions, looking directly at the camera, with natural highlights and a sense of interaction. Overall realistic, the skin has natural texture, do not use anime faces, silicone feel, or excessive skin smoothing. The makeup carries the charm of opera but leans towards a high-fashion portrait style, not heavy stage faces or mask-like styles.

The clothing is an Oriental opera haute couture design, emphasizing "heavy and light": headwear, pearls and emeralds, embroidery, back flags, or palace dress structures are exquisite and heavy; water sleeves, silk ribbons, and gauze layers are light and ethereal. The overall look is not overly wrapped, preserving the character's tension.

The upper body of the character is significantly higher than the paper surface, with real volume and shadows. One hand lightly supports the paper surface, and the other hand naturally touches elements like headwear or water sleeves, with a natural posture.

Visual transition: The main body of the character is completely realistic; water sleeves, silk ribbons, and back flags can have a small amount of light-colored hand-painted texture; only the ends of the water sleeves, the tails of the silk ribbons, a corner of the skirt, and the bottom right corner retain unfinished pencil line drawings.

In the bottom right corner, there is a real hand holding a pencil continuing to draw. The text and annotations on the paper are all in a pencil-handwritten draft style (such as headwear structure, water sleeve flow, embroidery instructions, etc.), not printed fonts.

The desktop can include elements such as color cards, pearls and emeralds, flower hairpins, fabric samples, pencils, needle pens, and tea cups. The overall style is realistic, clear, and high-end, with Oriental opera aesthetics and a "Paper Comes True" visual effect.

Avoid problems such as cartoonishness, plastic feel, cheap opera costumes, characters being too small or improper composition, hand deformities, and low image resolution.

生成一张《纸上成真 · 戏韵妆造稿》风格图片，4:5 竖版。

主题为【京剧花旦 / 刀马旦 / 昆曲水袖 / 贵妃醉酒】。画面是一张米白色戏曲妆造设定稿纸夹在木质画板上，置于温暖木色工作台。一位写实成年中国女性从纸上自然立起，形成“纸上成真”的视觉效果。

人物为半身偏多构图，脸部清晰、比例较大，直视镜头，有自然高光与互动感。整体写实，皮肤自然有纹理，不要动漫脸、硅胶感或过度磨皮。妆面带戏曲神韵，但偏高定写真风，不要厚重舞台脸或脸谱化。

服饰为东方戏曲高定设计，强调“重与轻”：头饰、珠翠、刺绣、靠旗或宫装结构偏精致厚重；水袖、披帛、纱层偏轻盈飘逸。整体不过度包裹，保留人物张力。

人物上半身明显高于纸面，有真实体积与投影。一只手轻撑纸面，另一只手自然触碰头饰或水袖等元素，姿态自然。

画面过渡：人物主体为完整写实；水袖、披帛、靠旗等可带少量淡彩手绘质感；仅在水袖末端、披帛尾端、裙边一角及右下角保留未完成铅笔线稿。

右下角有一只真实手持铅笔继续绘制。纸面文字与标注均为铅笔手写草稿风（如头饰结构、水袖走势、刺绣说明等），不要印刷体。

桌面可加入色卡、珠翠、花簪、布样、铅笔、针管笔、茶杯等元素。整体风格写实、清晰、高级，具有东方戏曲审美与“纸上成真”的视觉效果。

避免卡通感、塑料感、廉价戏服、人物过小或构图不当、手部畸形、画面低清晰度等问题。

title: 现代足球世界杯高端运动海报
prompt:
Create a premium sports editorial poster in a modern FIFA World Cup campaign style. The composition features a full-body professional football player standing confidently in the center with arms stretched wide in a victory pose, looking slightly upward with a determined expression. Behind the player is an oversized bold white jersey number occupying most of the background, creating a striking layered composition. The background is a solid national team color with a subtle textured grain finish (red for Portugal, yellow for Brazil, or matching any selected team). The player stands in front of the giant number with realistic shadows and perfect depth separation.

Place the player’s surname in a clean futuristic geometric font at the top-left, while the national team crest is positioned at the top-right. At the bottom-left, display the jersey number in oversized bold typography followed by a period (e.g., “7.” or “10.”). At the bottom-right, add compact editorial information including tournament title, national team, player position, captain designation (if applicable), and a stylish barcode graphic separated by a thin vertical accent line.

Maintain a minimal, luxury editorial aesthetic with perfect alignment, generous negative space, crisp typography, and premium sports branding. Use ultra-realistic lighting, sharp jersey details, visible fabric texture, natural skin tones, realistic shadows, high contrast, and cinematic color grading. The design should resemble an official World Cup player campaign poster created by a top sports creative agency.

Style: Modern editorial, sports branding, premium poster, minimalist graphic design, clean typography, geometric layout, bold oversized number, ultra-realistic, photorealistic, commercial quality, high-end sports advertisement, 8K, HDR, razor-sharp details, magazine cover aesthetic.

创建一个现代 FIFA 世界杯宣传风格的高端体育编辑海报。构图特征为一名职业足球运动员全身自信地站在中心，双臂张开呈胜利姿势，眼神坚定地微微向上看。球员身后是一个巨大的粗体白色球衣号码，占据了大部分背景，创造出引人注目的分层构图。背景是纯色的国家队颜色，带有细腻的纹理颗粒感（葡萄牙为红色，巴西为黄色，或匹配任何选定的球队）。球员站在巨大号码前，具有真实的阴影和完美的深度分离。

球员的姓氏以简洁的未来主义几何字体置于左上角，而国家队队徽位于右上角。在左下角，以超大粗体排版显示球衣号码，后跟一个句点（例如，“7.”或“10.”）。在右下角，添加紧凑的编辑信息，包括赛事名称、国家队、球员位置、队长标识（如果适用），以及由细垂直装饰线分隔的时尚条形码图形。

保持极简、奢华的编辑美学，具有完美的对齐、充足的留白空间、清晰的排版和高端体育品牌感。使用超现实的照明、锐利的球衣细节、可见的织物纹理、自然的肤色、真实的阴影、高对比度和电影级的色彩分级。设计应类似于由顶级体育创意机构制作的世界杯官方球员宣传海报。

风格：现代编辑、体育品牌、高端海报、极简平面设计、整洁排版、几何布局、粗体大号码、超写实、写实摄影、商业品质、高端体育广告、8K、HDR、锐利的细节、杂志封面美学。

title: 街头少女超写实人像混合媒体艺术拼贴
prompt:
Ultra-realistic editorial street portrait of a young woman standing on a lively downtown avenue, framed from the waist up and photographed from a subtle low perspective. She faces the camera with a relaxed, confident expression and a gentle natural smile. Styled in a loose cream-white tee paired with light-wash denim jeans or tailored beige pants, accented with delicate gold jewelry and effortless grooming.
The background features a sunlit cityscape with modern storefronts, brick facades, fire escapes, passing pedestrians, and a clear blue afternoon sky. Bright, optimistic atmosphere with warm natural daylight and soft urban reflections.
Integrated mixed-media collage aesthetic layered over the photograph: expressive neon coral and turquoise sketch lines outlining the figure, freeform paint streaks, hand-drawn loops, marker scribbles, semi-transparent paper cutouts, organic geometric shapes, textured brush marks, playful doodles, and layered graphic elements that appear physically pasted onto the image. Creative and energetic while maintaining strong visual balance.
Additional tactile details include subtle print imperfections, vintage poster texture, faint paper creases, light film grain, soft edge distressing, delicate color shifts, and a contemporary magazine-collage finish. The subject remains crisp, realistic, and highly detailed, while the artistic overlays add a handcrafted, youthful, fashion-forward feel. Depth of field: medium (f/5.6–f/8), full body in focus, smooth background.

Clean high-end fashion photography, lookbook style, high resolution, realistic textures, natural skin, no over-retouching.

title: 午睡之后窗边舒展的日系少女
prompt:
Theme:
After a nap

Person · Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige natural skin tone, soft oval face shape, delicate eye contours, natural bridge of the nose, pink-beige lips with a flush of color. Clear Japanese natural makeup, pale rose blush, long and thick eyelashes, moderate tear bags, naturally glossy lips. The expression is calm, with a hint of lingering sleepiness, a relaxed side profile. Eyes gently closed, an atmosphere as if stretching while quietly breathing deeply. Hair is dark brown, a low loose bun, keeping thin see-through bangs and stray hairs around the cheeks, a natural and elegant Japanese hairstyle.

Clothing · Pose:
White to ivory ultra-thin chiffon sleeveless loungewear. A long tank top style mini dress, with wide and deep armhole openings, the fabric hanging loosely at the sides of the body. The material is light as if containing air, with a large amount of afternoon light passing through, giving it a translucent feel. The inner silhouette is slightly visible through it, but overall maintaining an elegant and life-like expression. The fabric is soft, with long thin pleats falling from the chest to the hem, the hem length reaching the upper thigh. The person is standing sideways by the window, body facing the window on the left side of the screen, in a side angle. Both arms are raised high above the head, wrists gently overlapping. One leg bears the weight, the other leg extends slightly forward, knees soft and relaxed. A natural standing posture like stretching after waking up.

Background · Lighting:
Bright Japanese apartment bedroom. On the left side of the screen are large windows and white sheer curtains, on the right is a white linen bed and a wooden headboard. The bed is covered with white bedding, softly wrinkled sheets, and pillows with elegant patterns. A small round wooden side table is placed by the window, simply arranged with a small green plant and ceramic small items. The walls are pale grey-beige, with a simple wooden frame picture hanging on the upper right. Soft afternoon sunlight shines diagonally from the left side of the screen, warmly illuminating the person's face, neck, arms, shoulders, and legs. The main light source is natural light from the front left, slightly diffused through the curtains. Highlights are bright, and shadows extend softly to the right. Light enters through the edges and folds of the thin cloth, glowing white and gentle. Elegant strips of light and shadow extend across the floor and bed.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition, 3:4. The person is positioned center-right of the screen, a medium-long full-body shot including the arms raised from the head. Naturally including from the upper thigh to the fingertips at the top of the head. Windows are placed on the left and the bed on the right, creating a sense of depth. The lens is located near the height of the person's chest to shoulders, a natural line of sight that is neither high nor low, shot from the side. The side profile is beautiful, while the face is slightly angled toward the camera. The window side is bright, and the background bed is slightly and softly blurred. The focus is on the side profile, shoulders, arms, and the folds of the light-transmitting fabric, using a natural depth of field that is not too shallow.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo style. A Japanese portrait with a sense of peaceful afternoon life. The skin retains a natural sense of pores and soft flush, without excessive beauty retouching. The hair depicts fine stray hairs and delicate highlights when exposed to light. The chiffon material of the clothing is thin and light, meticulously expressing the overlapping, stitching, hem lines, and light-transmitting nuances of the fabric. The color palette is warm neutral colors, mainly ivory, beige, and wooden brown. Clean and smooth color gradients, a natural high-definition photo without noise. The overall texture presents a quiet, soft, afternoon lingering charm.

午睡之后

明亮的日本公寓卧室。画面左侧是大窗户和白色薄纱窗帘，右侧是白色亚麻床铺和木质床头板。床上铺着白色被褥，柔和褶皱的床单，淡雅图案的抱枕。窗边放置小型圆形木质边桌，简约摆放小型绿植和陶瓷小物。墙壁是淡灰米色，右上方挂着简约木框相框。午后的柔和阳光从画面左侧斜射而入，温暖地照亮人物的脸部、颈部、手臂、肩膀和腿部。主光源为左侧前方的自然光，通过窗帘略微扩散。高光明亮，阴影柔和地向右侧延伸。薄布的边缘和褶皱处透入光线，白皙而温柔地发光。地板和床上延伸出淡雅的条状光影。

逼真的照片风格。带有午后宁静生活感的日系肖像。皮肤保留自然的毛孔感和柔和血色，不过度美肌修饰。头发描绘细碎散落发丝和受光时的细腻高光。服装的雪纺材质薄而轻盈，细致表现布料的重叠、缝合、下摆线条、透光 nuance。色调以象牙白、米色、木质棕色为主的温暖中性色系。干净平滑的色阶，无噪点的自然高精细照片。整体呈现宁静柔和、午后余韵的质感。

promptEn:
A professional 3x3 collage featuring the same beautiful young woman photographed from the reference image with normal hair and eyeglasses from a top-down perspective on a soft white textured blanket. The woman appears in nine different creative scenes. Each panel contains hand-drawn black doodle illustrations interacting with her pose. Bright natural lighting, clean white background, high-end lifestyle photography, ultra-sharp details, magazine-quality composition, playful storytelling, realistic human proportions, consistent facial features across all nine panels.

Panel 1 (Athlete):

The young woman wears a sporty white crop top, black athletic shorts, and running shoes. She is captured mid-jump as if leaping over a hand-drawn hurdle obstacle. Dynamic action pose, energetic expression.

Panel 2 (Circus Performer):

The woman wears a red circus-inspired outfit with gold accents. She balances on one foot atop a hand-drawn circus drum while raising both hands for balance. Cheerful confident smile.

Panel 3 (Ice Cream Lover):

The woman wears a pastel pink summer dress and white sneakers. She sits between two hand-drawn café chairs while holding a large doodle ice cream cone near her mouth. Cute and playful expression.

Panel 4 (Superhero):

The woman wears a stylish superhero costume with a flowing cape, fitted bodysuit, and boots. She raises both fists triumphantly toward the sky. Large hand-drawn cape extension behind her. Heroic expression.

Panel 5 (Vacation Mode):

The woman wears a tropical floral dress, sunglasses resting beside her, and sandals. She relaxes on a hand-drawn beach towel with hands behind her head. Nearby doodles include sunscreen and flip-flops. Peaceful vacation vibe.

Panel 6 (Gym Struggle):

The woman wears a fitted gym outfit with leggings and training shoes. A giant doodle barbell appears beside her. She makes a funny exaggerated struggling face as if lifting impossible weight. Humorous fitness concept.

Panel 7 (Gymnast):

The woman wears a gymnastics leotard. She hangs between two hand-drawn gymnastics rings with a focused athletic expression. Strong and graceful pose.

Panel 8 (Shopping Queen):

The woman wears a fashionable modern outfit consisting of a blazer, skirt, and heels. She holds two shopping bags labeled "Shopping Day". Happy confident smile, luxury lifestyle mood.

Panel 9 (Rock Star):

The woman wears a black leather jacket, ripped jeans, boots, bracelets, and a bandana. A hand-drawn electric guitar is positioned across her body. Rockstar pose with arms spread wide and confident expression.

Overall style: minimalist white aesthetic, hand-drawn black doodle illustrations, whimsical storytelling, clean flat-lay composition, Instagram viral trend, professional studio photography, ultra-realistic young woman, high detail, 8K quality, consistent appearance across all panels, bright soft lighting, modern lifestyle editorial.

prompt:
A high-resolution, close-up editorial-style portrait of a young woman standing against a textured gray concrete wall, captured with direct on-camera flash that creates a raw, moody, high-contrast aesthetic. She is positioned slightly angled to the side with her head tilted back and chin lifted, giving an effortlessly cool, candid expression. Her face has a fair, smooth complexion with a natural sheen from the flash, soft rosy blush across the cheeks, minimal eye makeup, lightly defined brows, and glossy natural pink lips that are slightly parted, conveying a relaxed yet confident mood. Wispy strands of her dark brown hair fall loosely across her face, partially covering one eye, while the rest of her hair is pulled back into a low, casual style, enhancing the spontaneous, fashion-editorial feel. Her eyes look slightly upward and past the camera, adding to the detached, artistic vibe. She is wearing a loose-fitting white oversized T-shirt with bold red typography reading “CALIFORNIA” across the chest, along with smaller black text underneath, giving a casual streetwear aesthetic. Small, subtle stud earrings are visible, adding minimal detail without distracting from the overall look. The lighting is harsh and frontal, producing sharp shadows behind her on the wall and emphasizing skin texture, hair strands, and fabric folds, while the background remains simple and uncluttered. The color palette is muted and neutral—gray wall, white shirt, and red lettering—allowing the subject’s face and expression to remain the focal point. The overall atmosphere feels intimate, modern, slightly gritty, and effortlessly stylish, like a candid fashion snapshot captured at night with flash photography. Use this uploaded photo as the only and exact face reference. The generated image must use this same face exactly as shown, without any changes to identity, facial structure, or expression.

title: 复古军绿色调的柯达胶片质感男像
prompt:
MAIN SUBJECT (IDENTITY) Use the person from the reference photo as the main subject. Keep their exact facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and expression perfectly unchanged preserve all realism, emotional depth, and subtle facial lighting. Allow changes only in camera position, background motion, and atmosphere. SCENE & COMPOSITION Vertical medium-shot studio portrait. The man sits on a simple wooden or metal stool, gentle half-profile torso turn. One leg crossed over the other for a relaxed, composed posture; hands resting naturally. Overall mood: quiet, calm, restrained. CLOTHING Shirt (top layer): Oversized shirt in faded olive, dusty khaki, or washed military green. Soft textured cotton, sleeves rolled to mid-forearm, natural subtle wrinkles. T-shirt (underlayer): Washed charcoal matte tee, no logos, slightly fitted under the shirt. Trousers: Wide-leg trousers in deep charcoal or washed black; matte heavy-duty cotton or wool blend, straight lines, minimal folds. Accessories: None or very minimal-eg. simple old-style metal watch. BACKGROUND Heavy matte fabric backdrop (velvet or thick cotton) in deep forest green, warm olive, or muted army green. Soft draping with subtle folds; warm gradient fall-off toward the edges. LIGHTING Warm nostalgic studio lighting (4500-5000K). Large softbox for wraparound illumination. Soft golden skin highlights, lifted shadows for a matte non-contrasty look. Mild rim light along cheek and hair; faint vignette around edges. Mood inspired by 70s early 90s studio portraits. CAMERA/OPTICAL LOOK 85mm vintage portrait lens, f/2.8 depth of field. Soft micro-contrast, slight halation, very fine film grain, matte warm-muted profile. COLOR/STYLE Warm nostalgic palette with muted military tones: golden skin, faded olive, dusty khaki, charcoal. Matte texture, lifted blacks, compressed highlights, subtle organic film grain. Overall: soft warm film portrait with restrained post-war aesthetic, Kodak Portra-inspired

主体（人物） 请以参考照片中的人物作为主体。保持其面部特征、发型、肤色和表情完全不变，保留所有的真实感、情感深度和微妙的面部光线。只允许改变相机位置、背景运动和氛围。 场景与构图 垂直中景工作室肖像。人物坐在一张简单的木凳或金属凳上，身体略微侧转。双腿交叉，姿态放松而沉着；双手自然放置。整体氛围：安静、平静、克制。 服装 衬衫（外层）：宽松的衬衫，颜色为褪色橄榄绿、灰卡其色或水洗军绿色。柔软的棉质面料，袖子卷至小臂中部，带有自然的细微褶皱。T 恤（内层）：水洗炭灰色哑光 T 恤，无标志，在衬衫下略微合身。裤子：深炭灰色或水洗黑色的阔腿裤；哑光重磅棉或羊毛混纺面料，线条笔直，褶皱极少。配饰：无或极少——例如，一块简单的老式金属手表。 背景 厚重的哑光织物背景布（天鹅绒或厚棉布），颜色为深森林绿、暖橄榄绿或柔和军绿色。柔软垂坠，带有细微褶皱；边缘处有温暖的渐变效果。 灯光 温暖怀旧的工作室灯光（4500-5000K）。大型柔光箱提供环绕式照明。柔和的金色皮肤高光，提升阴影，营造哑光、低对比度的外观。脸颊和头发边缘有轻微的轮廓光；边缘有淡淡的渐晕效果。灵感来源于 70 年代至 90 年代初的工作室肖像。 相机/光学效果 85mm 复古人像镜头，f/2.8 景深。柔和的微对比度，轻微的光晕，极细的胶片颗粒，哑光暖色调配置文件。 色彩/风格 温暖怀旧的调色板，带有柔和的军事色调：金色皮肤、褪色橄榄绿、灰卡其色、炭灰色。哑光质感，提升黑色，压缩高光，微妙的有机胶片颗粒。整体：柔和温暖的胶片肖像，带有克制的战后美学，灵感来自柯达 Portra 胶片。

title: 玻璃肌质感极简室内女性人像自拍
prompt:
A close-up selfie portrait of a woman with bright natural fair skin, featuring healthy, hydrated glowing skin with a very realistic glass skin effect, especially on the cheeks, tip of the nose, forehead, and T-zone. Her face remains natural and realistic, with slight subtle breakouts and faint acne marks still softly visible so the result does not look overly smoothed or artificial. The makeup is highly detailed yet still natural and radiant: lightweight even base makeup, dewy wet finish, thin concealer, soft pink blush on the cheeks, subtle highlighter on the cheekbones and nose tip, natural pink lip gloss with a healthy plump lip effect, neatly groomed dark brown natural eyebrows, naturally curled lashes, soft and clean eye makeup, not excessive. Her face looks fresh, feminine, and elegant.

She is in a modern minimalist indoor room, with a grayish-white wall background, a high ceiling with black decorative hanging lights and central air conditioning, and soft natural light coming from a side window that casts artistic shadow lines across her face, neck, and shoulders. The warm and gentle natural lighting creates an aesthetic, dreamy, clean, and high-end atmosphere. The background is simple, clean, and uncluttered so the main focus stays on the subject’s face and expression.

She wears a thin black tank top with a simple cut and small straps, giving a casual, clean, effortless, and fresh look. The pose is a half-body close-up selfie, with one hand raised above the head while holding or adjusting her hair, her head slightly tilted, shoulders relaxed, and her facial expression calm and soft. She looks directly into the camera with an elegant and natural aura. The pose feels relaxed yet graceful.

Her hair is styled in a relaxed messy bun secured with a transparent crystal claw clip, with a few thin front bangs softly framing the face. The hair texture looks smooth, light, and slightly shiny under the sunlight.

She wears small earrings and a delicate necklace with a tiny star-shaped pendant.

Camera angle: close-up portrait selfie, shot from slightly below eye level to eye level, framed to focus on the face and upper body, with an aesthetic composition that highlights the light on the skin, facial texture, and makeup details. HD, 8K, ultra sharp, aesthetic, soft natural contrast, realistic skin texture, cinematic daylight, clean composition, high detail, soft shadows, elegant minimal look.

Negative prompt (optional):
excessive makeup, overly blurred skin, plastic face, heavy beauty filter, dark lighting, stiff pose, busy background, overly saturated colors, lost skin texture, overly oval face, strange expression, artifacts, noise, low quality, overexposed, underexposed

一个女人的近距离自拍人像，拥有明亮的自然白皙皮肤，呈现出健康、水润、发光的皮肤，具有非常真实的玻璃肌效果，特别是在脸颊、鼻尖、额头和T区。她的脸保持自然和真实，轻微细微的粉刺和淡淡的痤疮印记仍然柔和可见，因此结果看起来不会过度平滑或人造。化妆细节高度丰富但依然自然且光彩照人：轻盈均匀的底妆、露水般的湿润质感、薄遮瑕、脸颊上柔和的粉红色腮红、颧骨和鼻尖微妙的高光、具有健康丰盈唇部效果的自然粉色唇彩、整洁自然的深褐色眉毛、自然卷曲的睫毛、柔和干净的眼妆，并不夸张。她的脸看起来清新、柔美且优雅。

title: 普拉提课后闪光灯下的汗水肌肉
prompt:
Tatum is attempting the 'perfectly imperfect' post-reformer selfie, ten minutes after her Pilates class ended. She’s sweaty and annoyed because the direct, overhead studio lighting keeps washing out her contour, so she resorted to the harsh iPhone flash in the dark corner by the water cooler. She’s trying to capture the subtle muscle definition in her abs and back, but the tight angle makes her look intensely focused on the screen, not the viewer. She is balancing the phone precariously on the water bottle refill station to get the high-angle shot.

Pilates 课结束后十分钟，Tatum 正在尝试拍一张“完美的不完美”普拉提器械后自拍。她汗流浃背，心烦意乱，因为工作室直射的顶灯一直把她的脸部轮廓照得模糊不清，所以她只好跑到饮水机旁边的黑暗角落，用刺眼的 iPhone 闪光灯拍照。她试图捕捉腹部和背部肌肉的细微线条，但过近的角度让她看起来全神贯注于屏幕，而不是观看者。她把手机摇摇晃晃地放在饮水机加水站上，以便拍出高角度的照片。

title: 怀旧火柴盒与印度女性人像摄影
prompt:
A cinematic, ultra-realistic close-up product photograph of a vintage cardboard matchbox resting on a rustic, weathered wooden table. The matchbox is slightly open, revealing a row of partially burned wooden matches with blackened tips, creating a nostalgic and mysterious mood. Printed on the top cover of the matchbox is a faded black-and-white portrait of a beautiful South Asian woman in traditional Indian attire, wearing elegant bridal jewelry including a maang tikka, jhumka earrings, layered pearl necklaces, and a small bindi. She has dramatic winged eyeliner, neatly tied braided hair, and a calm, confident expression while making direct eye contact with the viewer.
The matchbox edges are worn, stained, and aged with visible scratches, yellowing, and vintage paper texture, enhancing the antique aesthetic. Warm soft lighting from the upper left casts natural shadows across the wooden surface, emphasizing the texture of the wood grain, the cardboard, and the burned matchsticks. Shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the matchbox and portrait, subtle background blur, earthy brown tones, realistic imperfections, nostalgic atmosphere, editorial product photography, macro lens, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K, HDR, masterpiece quality.

白色背心，细肩带，纹理因模糊而丢失。

prompt:
Use the attached image as the primary facial reference with maximum precision. Preserve exact facial structure, natural asymmetry, skin tone, and recognizable identity through all aging and print degradation.

A recovered color photograph from an ordinary Saturday afternoon sometime in the late 1990s or early 2000s. Captured on a cheap disposable camera and rediscovered decades later inside a family photo album before being scanned into an untouched JPEG. The subject is sitting cross-legged on the kitchen counter while helping prepare snacks for visiting relatives. Someone nearby suddenly points a camera toward her and takes a quick photograph while she is laughing at something happening off-frame. One hand reaches toward a bowl of cut fruit while the other balances her on the countertop. The moment feels completely spontaneous, messy, and unimportant at the time it was captured.

OUTFIT:

Bright orange ribbed sleeveless top, loose denim shorts, simple necklace, dangling earrings.

HAIR:

Long dark hair with natural movement and two thin face-framing braids. Loose strands drift around the cheeks, forehead, and shoulders. Hair should never appear stiff, perfectly arranged, or frozen in place.

ENVIRONMENT:

A modest family kitchen with patterned curtains, plastic containers, fruit bowls, ceramic plates, old appliances, and everyday household clutter. Afternoon sunlight enters through a nearby window.

LIGHT BEHAVIOR:

Warm afternoon sunlight mixed with weak disposable-camera flash. The flash brightens the face and foreground while failing to fully overpower the ambient indoor light. Highlights appear slightly washed while shadows remain uneven.

CAMERA & FILM CHARACTERISTICS:

Cheap disposable-camera optics, visible film grain, soft corners, slight barrel distortion, mild focus inconsistency, weak flash power, low dynamic range, chromatic fringing, flattened highlights, and imperfect consumer-grade image quality.

PHOTO AGING & RECOVERY:

Authentic recovered-photo aging. Glossy photo-paper texture remains visible beneath the image. Fine dust particles, hairline scratches, paper fibers, scanner artifacts, fingerprint marks, surface abrasion, gloss deterioration, and handling wear appear throughout the frame. Long-term heat exposure has altered the print chemistry: soft amber-brown warming, uneven fading, smoke-like discoloration, dye migration, slight color separation, and aged-paper contamination affect the entire photograph. Highlights shift toward warm cream, shadows lose depth, and certain colors fade at different rates. The photograph feels physically stored, handled, exposed to heat, and rediscovered decades later.

COLOR SCIENCE:

Authentic late-1990s consumer print film affected by decades of storage and heat exposure. Warm paper-yellowing influences the image. Blues weaken, greens drift olive, reds and skin tones retain the strongest saturation, shadows lift into charcoal-brown, and highlights develop a faded cream cast from aging photo paper.

COMPOSITION:

Handheld snapshot framing with slight camera tilt, imperfect cropping, awkward subject placement, and genuine family-photo energy. Parts of the kitchen counter and nearby objects are partially cut by the frame as if the photographer quickly raised the camera without composing the shot.

--ar 4:5

promptEn:
Use the attached image as the primary facial reference with maximum precision. Preserve exact facial structure, natural asymmetry, skin tone, and recognizable identity through all aging and print degradation.

A recovered color photograph from an ordinary Saturday afternoon sometime in the late 1990s or early 2000s. Captured on a cheap disposable camera and rediscovered decades later inside a family photo album before being scanned into an untouched JPEG. The subject is sitting cross-legged on the kitchen counter while helping prepare snacks for visiting relatives. Someone nearby suddenly points a camera toward her and takes a quick photograph while she is laughing at something happening off-frame. One hand reaches toward a bowl of cut fruit while the other balances her on the countertop. The moment feels completely spontaneous, messy, and unimportant at the time it was captured.

OUTFIT:

Bright orange ribbed sleeveless top, loose denim shorts, simple necklace, dangling earrings.

HAIR:

Long dark hair with natural movement and two thin face-framing braids. Loose strands drift around the cheeks, forehead, and shoulders. Hair should never appear stiff, perfectly arranged, or frozen in place.

ENVIRONMENT:

A modest family kitchen with patterned curtains, plastic containers, fruit bowls, ceramic plates, old appliances, and everyday household clutter. Afternoon sunlight enters through a nearby window.

LIGHT BEHAVIOR:

Warm afternoon sunlight mixed with weak disposable-camera flash. The flash brightens the face and foreground while failing to fully overpower the ambient indoor light. Highlights appear slightly washed while shadows remain uneven.

CAMERA & FILM CHARACTERISTICS:

Cheap disposable-camera optics, visible film grain, soft corners, slight barrel distortion, mild focus inconsistency, weak flash power, low dynamic range, chromatic fringing, flattened highlights, and imperfect consumer-grade image quality.

PHOTO AGING & RECOVERY:

Authentic recovered-photo aging. Glossy photo-paper texture remains visible beneath the image. Fine dust particles, hairline scratches, paper fibers, scanner artifacts, fingerprint marks, surface abrasion, gloss deterioration, and handling wear appear throughout the frame. Long-term heat exposure has altered the print chemistry: soft amber-brown warming, uneven fading, smoke-like discoloration, dye migration, slight color separation, and aged-paper contamination affect the entire photograph. Highlights shift toward warm cream, shadows lose depth, and certain colors fade at different rates. The photograph feels physically stored, handled, exposed to heat, and rediscovered decades later.

COLOR SCIENCE:

Authentic late-1990s consumer print film affected by decades of storage and heat exposure. Warm paper-yellowing influences the image. Blues weaken, greens drift olive, reds and skin tones retain the strongest saturation, shadows lift into charcoal-brown, and highlights develop a faded cream cast from aging photo paper.

COMPOSITION:

Handheld snapshot framing with slight camera tilt, imperfect cropping, awkward subject placement, and genuine family-photo energy. Parts of the kitchen counter and nearby objects are partially cut by the frame as if the photographer quickly raised the camera without composing the shot.

--ar 4:5

Cheap disposable-camera optics, visible film grain, soft corners, slight barrel distortion, mild focus inconsistency, weak flash power, low dynamic range, chromatic fringing, flattened highlights, and imperfect consumer-grade image quality.

PHOTO AGING & RECOVERY:

Authentic recovered-photo aging. Glossy photo-paper texture remains visible beneath the image. Highlights shift toward warm cream, shadows lose depth, and certain colors fade at different rates. The image feels physically stored, handled, exposed to heat, and rediscovered decades later rather than simply scanned from a digital image.

prompt:
{NAME} in a provocative French maid costume poses confidently indoors.
She has defined eyebrows, and red lipstick. She’s wearing a classic black maid dress with short puffy sleeves, a semi-sheer black mesh panel across the chest, and white lace trim along the neckline, cuffs, and hem. A short white ruffled apron is tied around her waist, and she has a matching white lace maid headdress.
Her outfit is accessorized with black wrist cuffs featuring white lace, sheer white thigh-high stockings with a visible garter band on her raised thigh, and glossy black slingback stiletto high heels with signature red soles. In her right hand, she holds a small white feather duster near her shoulder.
Her pose is playful and seductive: she’s standing in front of a large beige fabric sofa, with her left leg bent and raised, foot resting on the sofa edge, while her right hand rests on her hip/thigh area, slightly lifting the skirt. The background includes brown-and-beige striped curtains and a decorative metal shelving unit with small items on the left.
The overall style is glamorous modeling photography with soft indoor lighting.

Ultra-photorealistic 3x3 Instagram-style candid selfie collage, nine frames of the same beautiful young woman at a warm luxury Japanese sushi bar, consistent face and identity across every panel. She has soft Mediterranean beauty, warm glowing skin, realistic pore texture, natural facial asymmetry, fluffy dark brows, almond-shaped brown eyes, long lashes, glossy nude-rose lips, dewy cheeks, subtle bronzer, soft blush, and confident flirtatious eye contact. Her hair is sleek dark brown, styled in a polished low bun with a clean middle part. She wears a fitted black backless evening dress with delicate thin chain straps crossing across her open back, elegant body-hugging silhouette, minimal gold jewelry, glossy pale-pink manicured nails.

Create a playful flirtatious 3x3 grid with different natural poses:
1. looking over her shoulder at the camera, hands softly together near her face, sultry gaze
2. close-up beauty selfie, glossy lips slightly parted, shoulders angled toward camera
3. soft smile with chin resting on hand, elegant eye contact
4. side-back pose showing the backless chain-strap dress, looking back with a confident half-smile
5. leaning on the sushi counter, elbows softly crossed, playful direct gaze
6. holding chopsticks near her lips, flirtatious smile, sushi plates in front
7. shy laughing pose, looking down, one hand near cheek
8. sitting slightly sideways on the chair, arched elegant posture, looking over shoulder
9. cinematic close portrait with warm restaurant lights and bamboo softly blurred behind her

Camera style: iPhone flash mixed with warm restaurant lighting, realistic high-end phone photography, sharp facial details, natural skin texture, glossy highlights on lips and shoulders, soft depth of field, flattering low-light realism, Pinterest aesthetic, viral Instagram collage, luxury dinner date vibe.

preserve the specified wardrobe as complete clothing, detailed realistic fabric folds and wrinkles visible, clothing covers the body appropriately, fully clothed styling, no nudity., Keep the specified outfit complete and fully visible where the framing allows, natural body proportions, no extra people unless specified, no visible text or logos unless explicitly requested.

She wears a romantic, short-sleeved pastel pink midi dress with a delicate floral pattern and ruffle details, accessorized with a simple gold pendant necklace and thin bracelets. In some views, she sits gracefully on a rustic, weathered wooden bench, while in others, she stands next to an old wooden trellis archway holding small white flowers. The background is a vibrant, softly blurred cottage garden filled with climbing pink roses, white foxgloves, and purple lavender along a stone pathway, captured with the warm, soft-focus aesthetic of classic film photography.

title: 暗影裁缝的致命华尔兹
prompt:
SUBJECTS:
Characters: A female haute couture tailor with an extremely lean and capable figure, arm muscle lines like steel wires, eyes cold and sharp as needle tips.
Clothing: A dark tactical vest incorporating cheongsam elements, bare arms, forearms wrapped with dark red silk wristbands (used to increase friction); slender fingers with metal fingertip guards.
Action Style: Integrating the inch-power of "Wing Chun" and the circular transitions of "Tai Chi". The movements follow a rhythm of (charging power -> extremely fast strike -> instant stillness), emphasizing the explosive power of the fingers and the tension of silk in the air.

ENVIRONMENT:
A dimly lit high-end private studio. The background is a wall-to-wall mahogany spool rack, with tens of thousands of color blocks forming a geometric aesthetic; in the center is a huge black marble cutting table with a mirror-like surface. A single-point focused industrial cold light hangs above, with tiny fiber particles floating in the air.

MOOD:
Extremely focused, chilling, gorgeous with a sense of ritual; movements as precise as a surgeon's, visually highly oppressive.

TIMELINE:
0:00-0:02: Close-up/Wide-angle POV. The tailor rests both hands on the black marble tabletop, head lowered and still. The camera rushes forward extremely fast, she suddenly looks up, eyes locking onto the camera (killer gaze). Her right hand grabs in the void, a bolt of dark purple heavy silk slides across the tabletop like a long snake, "locked" by her single hand.

0:02-0:05: Cut switch/Handheld feel. The tailor throws the satin into the air. Her figure is like an afterimage, holding a silver long scissors in her right hand, performing a "blind cut" the moment the satin falls. It is not ordinary cutting, but accompanied by the force of martial arts punching, the scissors slice through the air making a "hiss" sound of breaking the air, the fabric's cut is extremely neat, without the slightest mess.

0:05-0:07: Moving camera. She slides to the other end of the workbench with a side step. With a single horizontal sweep, several steel needles are shaken from the pincushion, suspended in mid-air. She pushes with applied force, the steel needles accurately sink into a distant hanger pattern like hidden weapons, the needle tails vibrate, emitting a metallic ringing sound.

0:07-0:10: Continuous shot. The tailor begins "thread control". She pulls out a gold thread, through the wrapping between her fingers, she controls the satin to automatically fold and take shape in the air like manipulating puppet strings. Every flick of her fingers is accompanied by spark-like static electricity. She hits the tabletop with her elbow, the presser foot bounces up, she instantly catches it and locks it dead onto the fabric.

0:10-0:12: Match cut. The tailor makes a sudden spin in place, the hem of her outer garment spreads out like a circular array. She brings her hands together, fiercely pulling the formed suit collar, the last gold thread draws a perfect arc in the air and automatically sews. The movement instantly cuts from extremely fast (afterimage) to extremely slow (freeze frame).

0:12-0:15: Stable POV. The dust settles. She lifts the finished dress with one hand, shakes it forcefully, the dress unfolds in front of the camera. The camera focuses on the exquisite embroidery on the collar. She lightly flicks the button with her fingernail—the button trembles. Then she turns and walks into the shadows, leaving a back view, the screen is completely covered by the rising mist of expensive perfume, cleanly fading out.

SUBJECTS (主体):
人物： 一位身形极度干练、手臂肌肉线条如钢丝般的女性高定裁缝，眼神冷冽如针尖。
着装： 融合了旗袍元素的深色战术马甲，双臂裸露，前臂缠绕着暗红色的丝绸护腕（用于增加摩擦力）；手指修长且指尖带有金属护具。 
动作风格： 融合了“咏春”的寸劲与“太极”的圆转。动作遵循（蓄力 → 极速出击 → 瞬间静止）的节奏，强调手指的爆发力和丝绸在空中的张力。

ENVIRONMENT (环境):
昏暗的高级私人工作室。背景是整面墙的红木线轴架，成千上万个色块形成几何美感；中心是一张巨大的黑色大理石裁剪台，表面光可鉴人。上方悬挂着单点聚焦的工业冷光灯，空气中漂浮着细微的纤维微粒。

MOOD (氛围):
极度专注、肃杀、带有仪式感的华丽；动作如外科医生般精确，视觉感官上极具压迫力。

TIMELINE (时间线):
0:00-0:02: 特写/广角POV。 裁缝双手撑在黑色大理石台面，低头静止。镜头极速推进，她猛然抬头，双眼锁定镜头（眼神杀）。右手虚空一抓，一匹暗紫色的重磅真丝像长蛇一样从台面滑过，被她单手“锁”住。

0:02-0:05: 剪辑切换/手持感。 裁缝将绸缎抛向空中。她身形如残影，右手持银色长剪，在绸缎下落的瞬间进行“盲剪”。不是普通的裁剪，而是伴随着武术出拳的劲道，剪刀划过空气发出“嗤”的破空声，布料断口极其平整，丝毫不乱。
0:05-0:07: 移动镜头。 她一个侧跨步滑到工作台另一端。单手横扫，数枚钢针从针垫上震起，悬浮在半空。她运劲一推，钢针像暗器一样精准没入远处的衣架样版中，针尾震颤，发出金属鸣音。

0:07-0:10: 连续镜头。 裁缝开始“控线”。她扯出一条金丝，通过手指指缝的缠绕，像操纵傀儡线一样控制绸缎在空中自动折叠、成型。每一次手指的弹拨都伴随着火花般的静电。她用肘部撞击台面，压脚弹起，她瞬间接住并锁死在面料上。

0:10-0:12: 匹配剪辑。 裁缝原地一个急转，外衣下摆如圆阵散开。她双手合拢，将成型的西装领口猛地一拉，最后一道金线在空中划出完美的弧线自动缝合。动作从极快（残影）瞬间切入极慢（定格）。

0:12-0:15: 稳定POV。 尘埃落定。她单手拎起成品礼服，用力一振，礼服在镜头前展开。镜头聚焦在领口的精美刺绣上。她用指甲轻弹纽扣——纽扣颤动。随后她转身走向阴影，留下一道背影，画面被升起的昂贵香水雾气完全覆盖，干净利落地淡出。

title: 绝世厨神泼油酸辣鱼
prompt:
Action subject@【@Image 1】wearing white chef's outfit
 0-2 seconds (starting the knife to butcher fish): leaning over to press the fish, cloth shoes stepping firmly on the stove, fast knife diagonally chops the fish head, blade slides along the backbone with one stroke, two halves of fish meat separate accordingly, fish fillet is flicked flying by finger wind and lands on the plate.
2-4 seconds (slicing fish into thin slices): fish meat is spread flat on the cutting board, wrist turns over, knife light weaves like a cloth, fish slices as thin as cicada wings are continuous without breaking the knife, when floating down they bring up slight, palm wind wraps the seasonings to quickly toss and mix, fish slices are evenly coated with batter, moist and glossy luster.
7-9 seconds (stir-frying ingredients to burst fragrance): iron pot is put on fire, when oil is hot toes hook over the pickled vegetable jar, pickled vegetables and pickled peppers are swept into the pot by palm wind, during stir-frying the sour and spicy aroma rushes to the sky, hem of the gown is lifted and swayed slightly by hot steam.

10-12 seconds (pouring oil to finish the move): hot oil is poured on minced garlic and dried chili peppers making a "sizzling" sound, when finishing the pose the corners of the gown drop down, pickled vegetables are yellow and bright, fish slices are snow white, in the hot steam floats mellow sour and spicy fragrance, then the camera freezes on this plate of boiling sour and spicy fish. 动作主体@【@图1】身穿白色厨师装

title: 掌风化刃的功夫厨神传说
prompt:
Subject@【@Image 1】
0-2 seconds (Opening): Close-up quick push-in, wearing Chinese-style clothing standing in front of the stove, sinking qi to the dantian pressing the table with one hand, knuckles exerting force to shake the diced chicken, peanuts, and dried chili peppers in the bowl to fly into the air simultaneously, ingredients suspended in mid-air.
2-4 seconds (Starting stance): Spinning body to initiate the stance, right hand like a sword finger quickly pointing at the diced chicken in the air, finger wind accurately slicing through the meat fibers, diced chicken instantly cut into uniform small pieces, falling into the hot oil iron wok in an arc in mid-air.
4-6 seconds (Palm wind stir-frying): Sinking waist into a horse stance, both palms exerting energy quickly towards the iron wok from a distance, palm wind enveloping the diced chicken to rotate at high speed in the wok, stir-frying until it changes color, the meat is tender and not dry, evenly coated with glossy oil.
6-8 seconds (Flying cutting ingredients): Side kick, toes lightly picking up cucumbers and carrots on the chopping board, fruits and vegetables flying in the air, raising hand with a fast knife slashing like lightning, instantly cut into cubes, accurately falling into the wok to join the diced chicken.
8-10 seconds (Stir-frying kung fu): Holding the wok handle with one hand, exerting force with the wrist to perform the ultimate wok-tossing skill, the iron wok flying up and down, diced chicken, peanuts, and chili peppers intertwining and flying in the air, not spilling a single drop of broth, the movement is as chic as sword dancing, full of wok hei.
10-15 seconds (Finishing move and plating): The final large-arc spinning wok, drawing an afterimage in the air, ingredients steadily fall into the wok, accurately plating the bright red, fragrant and crispy Kung Pao Chicken into a white porcelain plate, the finished dish steaming, the camera freezes on a delicious close-up with a blurred background of a fist-clasping figure, the picture should be smooth, following the plot, must have close-ups.

主体@【@图1】
0-2秒（开场）：近景快速推镜，身着中式服饰立于灶台前，气沉丹田单手按桌，指节发力震得碗中鸡丁、花生、干辣椒同时凌空飞起，食材悬浮半空。
2-4秒（起手式）：旋身起势，右手如剑指快速点向空中鸡丁，指风精准划开筋膜，鸡丁瞬间切为均匀小块，呈弧线凌空落入热油铁锅。
4-6秒（掌风滑炒）：沉腰扎马步，双掌隔空对着铁锅快速运劲，掌风裹挟鸡丁在锅中高速旋转、滑炒变色，肉质鲜嫩不柴，油光均匀包裹。
6-8秒（飞切配料）：侧身踢腿，脚尖轻挑案上黄瓜、胡萝卜，果蔬凌空，抬手快刀如闪电劈斩，瞬间切成方丁，精准落入锅中与鸡丁汇合。
8-10秒（翻炒功夫）：单手持锅柄，手腕发力使出翻锅绝技，铁锅上下翻飞，鸡丁、花生、辣椒在空中交织飞舞，不洒一滴汤汁，动作潇洒如舞剑，锅气十足。
10-15秒（收招成菜）：最后一记大弧度旋锅，在空中划出一道残影，食材稳稳落锅，将色泽红亮、鲜香酥脆的宫保鸡丁精准盛入白瓷盘，成品热气升腾，镜头定格美味特写虚化背景抱拳的，画面要流畅，按剧情，要有特写

title: 兰博基尼公牛觉醒狂飙广告
prompt:
Cinematic Lamborghini brand creative commercial, hyper-realistic, first-person high-speed tracking shot, extreme visual impact, silky smooth continuous camera movement, overall vibe high-end, cold, highly aggressive. Create a minimalist but extremely aggressive first-person high-speed weaving commercial. No low-quality cyber morphing, do not directly and stiffly turn the entire bull into a car, but through close-up details, reflections, structural lines, and visual transitions, naturally translate the bull's raw power and explosive feel into Lamborghini's mechanical sculpture sense, aerodynamics, and extreme speed. No background music throughout, only high-quality foley and spatial sound effects. Total duration under 15 seconds, there must be a clear visual upgrade every 3 seconds, avoid flat and dragging single shots.
[0-3s] In a dark and deep black metallic texture space, a frenzied bull, entirely deep black, with extremely clear muscle lines, and restrained metallic cold light on its skin surface, suddenly charges out at high speed. The camera follows closely in first-person at high speed right beside and in front of the bull's head, almost grazing the horns, forehead bone lines, neck muscles, and the undulating shoulders and back as it charges forward. The opening must have an extreme in-your-face oppressive feeling, no flat angles, no ordinary running shots, it should feel like speed and power are directly thrust into the camera, wind pressure hitting the face, the image is extremely minimalist, only retaining a small amount of cold white highlights, black shadows, air oppression, and speed afterimages.
[3-5s] The camera suddenly presses forward and accelerates, pushing to an extreme close-up of the bull's eye and the root of the horn, the gaze carries a cold aggressiveness, in the reflection appears a sharp cold white light blade, orange energy afterglow, and metallic facet highlights. Using the curve of the horn, the reflection in the eye, and the bone structure to make a seamless transition, instantly connecting to a close-up of the Lamborghini's headlight, wedge-shaped nose, and sharp creases. This transition must be silky smooth, extremely fast, high-end, as if the Lamborghini was originally lurking within the bull's power structure.
[5-8s] After entering the world of the Lamborghini's front end and headlights, the camera continues to charge forward at high speed in first-person, skimming past the sharp light cluster, low front hood, extremely sharp front face creases, air intakes, and wedge contour from the side front of the car. The camera glides at high speed along the car's shoulder line, continuing the inertia of charging forward right against the bull's muscles and bone lines just now, allowing the biological explosive structure to naturally transition into mechanical curved surfaces and blade-like creases. The overall color is mainly Lamborghini's signature bright yellow or matte black main body, paired with black shadows, cold white metallic highlights, and a small amount of orange thermal reflection, restrained, high-end, dangerous.
[8-11s] The camera continues to accelerate, skimming past the sharp curved surfaces on the side of the car, diving towards the wheels and tires, shuttling at high speed close to the ground. The wheel rotation, brake calipers, carbon fiber side skirts, air channels, door cut lines, and rear aerodynamic structures flash by in sequence. The camera movement should feel like being dragged forward by an uncontrollable violent speed, continuous diving, side circling, low-to-ground forward pressing, grazing past the edges of the car's creases and gaps, maintaining an extremely strong first-person perspective thrill. The camera language emphasizes the oppressive feeling of mechanical bestiality, no gentleness, no elegant wandering, it should look like a furious supercar tearing through the air.
[11-13s] The camera charges forward quickly once again, the entire Lamborghini body is fully established within the speed, the wedge-shaped low proportion, sharp light clusters, exaggerated intake structure, sculpted curved surfaces on the side of the car, wide wheel sets, and extremely aggressive posture are all clearly formed. title: 日式动漫ACT游戏废土宗师电影级激战
prompt:
Japanese anime 3D game CG, ACT action game perspective, cinematic battle performance, camera closely follows the protagonist throughout, high-octane, high-speed, high-impact feeling. Protagonist appearance references Image 1, characterized as a martial arts grandmaster, extremely strong in close-range melee combat, exuding immense oppression. Scene set in a doomsday wasteland world, yellow sand filling the sky, dust drifting down, ruins and dilapidated ancient-style buildings interspersed, overall atmosphere is desolate, solemn, with Eastern apocalyptic aesthetics. Opening shot rapidly pushes in on the protagonist, wind and sand sweep past, tension fills the air. First wave of over a dozen minions attacks simultaneously, protagonist instantly erupts, using extremely fluid and fierce melee combos to continuously kill in seconds, actions include dodge dash, heavy punch to the face, elbow strike to break defense, leg sweep to topple, aerial pursuit, ground impact shockwave, combos as smooth as a one-take shot, every punch hits flesh, enemies are knocked flying, smashed into the ground, rolling, crashing into walls, strong hit feedback. Battle includes massive environmental destruction: walls cracking, debris exploding, ground shattering, dust shooting into the sky, enemies crashing through ruins, reinforcing the power impact. After clearing the field, camera pauses briefly, Boss entrance animation begins. Boss emerges from the depths of the sand and dust, accompanied by an oppressive close-up, low-angle looking up shot, footsteps shaking the ground, wind pressure surging, powerful aura. Subsequently, the protagonist and Boss engage in two rounds of high-speed close-quarters fierce combat, camera closely follows the protagonist's movement, actions are sharp and fierce, including parrying, dodging, counter-attacking, fist clashes, close-range suppression, explosive heavy hits, presenting the speed and power of a duel between masters. Finally, the protagonist charges up and unleashes an ultimate move, afterimage dash, continuous heavy hits, frontally blasting through the Boss's defense, one-hit kill. Ending shows the Boss crashing heavily to the ground, ruins exploding, dust waves surging to the sky, ground cracking, screen is shocking, climax maxed out. Requirements: overall movements natural and coherent, combat clear, camera cool but not chaotic, highlighting the satisfaction, oppression, and finishing burst of ACT game CG level.

日式动漫 3D 游戏 CG，ACT 动作游戏视角，电影级战斗演出，全程紧跟主角，高燃、高速、高打击感。

主角形象参考图片1，设定为武术宗师，近战体术极强，压迫感十足。场景为末日废土世界，黄沙漫天，尘埃飘落，废墟与残破古风建筑交错，整体气质苍凉、肃杀、带东方末世美学。

开场镜头快速推进主角，风沙掠过，气氛压满。第一波十几只小怪同时扑来，主角瞬间爆发，使用极其流畅凶狠的体术连击连续秒杀，动作包含闪身突进、重拳轰脸、肘击破防、扫腿放倒、腾空追击、落地震荡，连招一镜到底般顺滑，拳拳到肉，敌人被击飞、砸地、翻滚、撞墙，受击反馈强烈。

战斗中加入大量环境破坏：墙体龟裂、碎石炸裂、地面崩碎、尘土冲天、敌人撞碎残垣，强化力量冲击。

清场后，镜头短暂停顿，Boss 登场动画开始。Boss 从沙尘深处现身，伴随压迫感特写、低机位仰拍、脚步震地、风压翻涌，气场强大。

随后主角与 Boss 展开两轮高速近身激战，镜头紧贴主角移动，动作凌厉凶猛，包含格挡、闪避、反击、对拳、贴身压制、爆发重击，呈现高手对决的速度感与力量感。

最终主角蓄势爆发终极大招，残影冲刺，连续重击，正面轰穿 Boss 防御，一击秒杀。结尾展现 Boss 重重坠地、废墟爆裂、尘浪冲天、地面裂开，画面震撼，高潮拉满。

要求整体动作自然连贯，战斗清晰，镜头酷炫但不混乱，突出 ACT 游戏 CG 级别的爽感、压迫感与终结爆发。

title: 猫咪深夜食堂手作拉面
prompt:
Create a short video themed around a cat making handmade ramen in a late-night diner, cinematic color grading (warm tones, full of worldly atmosphere), fine grain, shallow depth of field.
The protagonist is a cat, playing the role of a professional ramen master, whose appearance strictly refers to [@[@Image 1]].
The scene is set in front of a late-night ramen stall full of Japanese style on a city street. The background features warm yellow lanterns, a wooden bar counter, and blurred street neon lights in the distance.
The video content needs to be displayed in the following storyboard steps:

Kneading and cutting dough: The cat wears a small apron, rhythmically kneading the dough on a wooden cutting board sprinkled with flour, and then using a sharp dough knife to cut the dough into even fine noodles.

Boiling and shaking dry: The cat scatters the noodles and throws them into a large boiling pot, a few seconds later uses a bamboo skimmer to scoop up the noodles, and skillfully and forcefully shakes them twice in the air to shake off the excess water.

Seasoning the soup base: The cat holds a delicate long-handled spoon, scoops out a spoonful of soup from the pot of richly simmered white bone broth, and slowly pours it into a large dark blue ceramic bowl.

Plating: The cat neatly puts the cooked noodles in with chopsticks, and then places two thick slices of chashu, half a soft-boiled egg, a few pieces of seaweed, and chopped green onions on top of the noodles in sequence, with delicate movements.

Ending: In the final shot, the cat master gently pushes this steaming bowl of ramen emitting white smoke towards the camera, and nods slightly as a gesture.

Requirements:

Video style: Realistic, clear picture, medium shot.

Sound (ASMR): The entire video does not require voice-over narration, but needs to amplify: the "da-da" sound when cutting noodles, the "hua-la" sound when noodles enter the water, the "sa-sa" sound when shaking off water, the flowing sound when hot soup enters the bowl, etc.

Background music: There is soft, soothing saxophone music in the background, creating a tranquil late-night atmosphere.

要求：

视频风格： 写实，画面清晰，中景。

声音（ASMR）： 整个视频不需语音旁白，但要放大：切面时的“哒哒”声、面条入水的“哗啦”声、甩干水分的“飒飒”声、热汤入碗的流动声等。

背景音乐： 背景有轻柔、舒缓的萨克斯风音乐，营造静谧的深夜氛围。

title: 室外旋转木马的春日白天场景
prompt:
Original characters: child girl from (image1) on the left side of the frame and adult woman from (image2) on the right side, as if they are two versions of the same person, sitting opposite each other on the bench of a classic children's carousel. The carousel rotates at a normal rhythm; blurred motion background behind — blooming spring trees, soft bokeh, bright daylight.    

Warm, hopeful, joyful mood; both softly smiling, with curious shining eyes and relaxed body language, like a sincere uplifting conversation with your younger self. Poses natural, turned toward each other, fully immersed in the moment.    

Spring daytime setting on an outdoor carousel: painted wooden structure in pastel colors, metal poles, subtle motion blur from rotation. Airy fresh atmosphere, hints of green blooming trees in the background, no dark yard or park bench.    

Facial expressions light and happy, no sadness. Subtle natural facial animation.    

Dialogue in English, one sentence each, subtle lip-sync:  
Child: "So… what happens next to me?"  
Adult: "You can't even imagine how much interesting, beautiful stuff is waiting for you."    

No subtitles, no text, no captions.

原始角色：来自（image1）的女童在画面左侧，来自（image2）的成年女性在右侧，仿佛她们是同一个人的两个版本，坐在经典儿童旋转木马的长椅上，面对面而坐。旋转木马以正常节奏旋转；背景模糊运动——盛开的春树，柔和的散景，明亮的日光。

温暖、充满希望、欢乐的情绪；两人柔和微笑，眼睛闪耀着好奇光芒，身体语言放松，像与年轻时的自己进行真诚鼓舞人心的对话。姿势自然，面向彼此，完全沉浸在当下。

面部表情轻松快乐，没有悲伤。微妙的自然面部动画。

无字幕，无文字，无说明。
